Table land.orri {
  orri_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the overriding royalty interest record. Primary key.']
  lease_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the lease from which this ORRI is carved. ORRIs are typically associated with a specific lease or well.']
  royalty_owner_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the party (individual or entity) who holds the ORRI. Commonly geologists, brokers, landmen, or consultants who were granted the interest as compensation.']
  venture_partner_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to venture.partner. Business justification: ORRI holders are often venture partners. Venture_partner_id tracks the payee, enables payment processing, supports JIB netting, and ensures proper tax reporting for partner-held overriding royalties.']
  well_asset_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the specific well to which this ORRI applies, if the ORRI is well-specific rather than lease-wide.']
  conversion_date date [note: 'The date on which the ORRI was converted to another interest type, if conversion has occurred.']
  conversion_trigger varchar [note: 'Description of the conditions or events that trigger conversion of the ORRI to another interest type, if applicable.']
  convertible_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the ORRI is convertible to another interest type (typically working interest) under specified conditions.']
  cost_bearing_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the ORRI holder bears any costs. By definition, ORRIs are non-cost-bearing, so this should typically be False. Included for completeness and exception handling.']
  country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country in which the ORRI property is located.']
  county_name varchar [note: 'The county in which the lease or well associated with this ORRI is located.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp indicating when this ORRI record was first created in the system.']
  creation_instrument_reference varchar [note: 'Document reference number or identifier for the legal instrument that created the ORRI, used for title research and audit purposes.']
  creation_instrument_type varchar [note: 'The type of legal instrument that created or granted the ORRI. Common instruments include deeds, assignments, farmout agreements, leases with ORRI provisions, consulting agreements, and brokerage agreements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: deed|assignment|farmout_agreement|lease|consulting_agreement|brokerage_agreement|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  cumulative_payout_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The cumulative amount paid to the ORRI holder to date, used to track progress toward payout threshold for payout-based ORRIs.']
  decimal decimal(18,10) [note: 'The decimal fraction representing the ORRI holder\'s share of gross production revenue. For example, 0.0125 represents a 1.25% ORRI.']
  depth_from_feet decimal(10,2) [note: 'The starting depth in feet for depth-limited ORRIs. The ORRI applies only to production from this depth and below.']
  depth_to_feet decimal(10,2) [note: 'The ending depth in feet for depth-limited ORRIs. The ORRI applies only to production from above this depth.']
  division_order_date date [note: 'The date on which the division order was issued for this ORRI.']
  division_order_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a division order has been issued for this ORRI, authorizing revenue distribution to the holder.']
  effective_date date [note: 'The date on which the ORRI becomes effective and the holder begins to receive revenue distributions.']
  formation_name varchar [note: 'The geological formation to which the ORRI applies, for formation-specific ORRIs.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp indicating when this ORRI record was last updated in the system.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-form text field for additional comments, special conditions, or administrative notes related to the ORRI.']
  orri_number varchar [note: 'Business identifier for the ORRI, typically assigned by the operator or land department for tracking and reference purposes.']
  orri_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the ORRI. Active indicates the ORRI is currently in effect and revenue is being distributed; suspended indicates temporary hold on payments; terminated indicates the ORRI has ended; pending indicates the ORRI is awaiting activation; converted indicates the ORRI has been converted to another interest type.']
  orri_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the ORRI based on its termination conditions. Perpetual ORRIs continue indefinitely; convertible ORRIs convert to working interest under certain conditions; payout-based ORRIs terminate after cost recovery; term-limited ORRIs expire after a specified period; depth-limited ORRIs apply only to specific depth intervals; formation-specific ORRIs apply only to designated formations.']
  payout_status varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the ORRI is in pre-payout or post-payout status. Not applicable for non-payout-based ORRIs.']
  payout_threshold_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The cumulative revenue or cost recovery amount at which a payout-based ORRI terminates. Applicable only to payout-based ORRIs.']
  payout_threshold_currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the payout threshold amount. Typically USD for U.S. operations.']
  percentage decimal(7,4) [note: 'The percentage representation of the ORRI decimal for reporting and display purposes. For example, 1.2500 represents 1.25%.']
  product_type varchar [note: 'The type of hydrocarbon product to which the ORRI applies. Can be oil-only, gas-only, natural gas liquids (NGL)-only, or all products.']
  recording_date date [note: 'The date on which the ORRI instrument was recorded in the county or jurisdiction land records.']
  recording_reference varchar [note: 'The book, page, or instrument number assigned by the county recorder\'s office when the ORRI instrument was recorded.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the source system from which this ORRI record originated, typically Quorum Land System or SAP Joint Venture Accounting.']
  state_province_code varchar [note: 'Two-letter state or province code for the jurisdiction in which the ORRI property is located.']
  suspense_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether revenue payments to the ORRI holder are currently held in suspense due to title issues, missing documentation, or other administrative holds.']
  suspense_reason varchar [note: 'Description of the reason why revenue payments are held in suspense, if applicable.']
  termination_condition varchar [note: 'Description of the conditions under which the ORRI will terminate, such as payout thresholds, time limits, depth restrictions, or conversion triggers.']
  termination_date date [note: 'The date on which the ORRI terminates or is scheduled to terminate, if applicable. Null for perpetual ORRIs.']
  title_opinion_reference varchar [note: 'Reference to the title opinion document that validates the ORRI holder\'s interest and chain of title.']
  title_status varchar [note: 'Status of the title opinion for this ORRI. Clear indicates no title defects; defective indicates title issues exist; pending review indicates title examination is in progress; curative required indicates remedial action is needed.']

  Note: 'Master record for Overriding Royalty Interests (ORRI) — non-cost-bearing interests carved out of the working interest that entitle the holder to a fraction of gross production revenue. Captures ORRI holder, decimal fraction, lease or well reference, creation instrument, effective date, termination conditions (convertible ORRI, payout-based ORRI), and current status. ORRIs are commonly granted to geologists, brokers, and landmen as compensation. Distinct from royalty interests which are carved from the mineral estate.'
}

Table land.curative_action {
  curative_action_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the title curative action record. Primary key.']
  afe_budget_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to procurement.afe_budget. Business justification: Title curative is AFE line item (legal fees, document recording). Existing afe_number is denormalized; replace with FK for proper cost tracking against capital project budgets.']
  compliance_corrective_action_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.corrective_action. Business justification: Title curative actions may be required by regulatory corrective actions following audits or violations. Links land title remediation to compliance remediation for integrated tracking and closure verif']
  finance_afe_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.finance_afe. Business justification: Title curative work (missing deeds, heirship determinations, quiet title actions) incurs legal costs charged to drilling or acquisition AFEs. Required for cost tracking when curative blocks operations']
  joa_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: Title curative actions are required before JOA operations can proceed. Joa_id links curative work to the governing agreement, enabling AFE cost allocation and partner consent tracking.']
  lease_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the lease agreement affected by the title defect requiring curative action.']
  primary_curative_employee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the landman or land professional assigned responsibility for completing the curative action.']
  quaternary_curative_assigned_landman_employee_id varchar [note: 'FK to workforce.employee']
  tertiary_curative_approved_by_user_employee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the user who approved the curative action for execution.']
  title_opinion_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the title opinion that identified the defect requiring curative action.']
  tract_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to land.tract. Business justification: Curative actions address title defects on specific land parcels (tracts). The curative_action has county_name and state_province_code that duplicate tract attributes. Adding tract_id FK allows normali']
  well_asset_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the well for which curative action is required before drilling or division order preparation.']
  actual_cost decimal(15,2) [note: 'Actual cost incurred to complete the curative action, including all legal fees, recording fees, landman time, and consideration paid.']
  affected_acreage decimal(12,4) [note: 'Total acreage affected by the title defect requiring curative action. Measured in acres.']
  affected_net_revenue_interest decimal(10,6) [note: 'Net Revenue Interest (NRI) percentage affected by the title defect. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.187500 represents 18.75% NRI).']
  affected_working_interest decimal(10,6) [note: 'Working Interest (WI) percentage affected by the title defect. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.250000 represents 25% WI).']
  approval_date date [note: 'Date when the curative action was formally approved for execution by authorized management or legal counsel.']
  approval_required_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean indicator whether the curative action requires management or legal approval before execution. True indicates approval workflow is required.']
  assigned_date date [note: 'Date when the curative action was formally assigned to a landman for resolution.']
  blocking_division_order_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean indicator whether this curative action must be completed before division orders can be prepared and revenue distributed. True indicates division order processing is blocked.']
  blocking_drilling_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean indicator whether this curative action must be completed before drilling operations can commence. True indicates drilling is blocked until resolution.']
  completion_date date [note: 'Actual date when the curative action was completed and the title defect was resolved to achieve marketable title.']
  cost_center_code varchar [note: 'Cost center code for financial allocation of curative action expenses within the enterprise resource planning system.']
  cost_currency_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for curative action costs (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP).']
  country_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the affected lease is located (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX).']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the curative action record was first created in the system. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  curative_action_number varchar [note: 'Business identifier for the curative action, typically assigned by the land department for tracking and reference purposes.']
  curative_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the curative action. Tracks progress from identification through resolution.']
  curative_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the type of curative action required to resolve the title defect. Common types include missing heir affidavit, probate, correction deed, ratification, release of lien, quiet title action, and curative affidavit. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: missing heir affidavit|probate|correction deed|ratification|release of lien|quiet title action|curative affidavit — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  defect_description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the title defect identified in the title opinion that necessitates curative action. Describes the specific issue affecting marketable title.']
  document_reference varchar [note: 'Reference identifier or file path to the curative instrument document stored in the document management system.']
  due_date date [note: 'Target completion date for the curative action, typically driven by drilling schedule or Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) approval timeline.']
  estimated_cost decimal(15,2) [note: 'Estimated cost to complete the curative action, including legal fees, recording fees, landman time, and any consideration paid to resolve the defect.']
  gl_account_code varchar [note: 'General Ledger (GL) account code for posting curative action costs in the financial system.']
  identified_date date [note: 'Date when the title defect was identified in the title opinion, triggering the need for curative action.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the curative action record was last updated in the system. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  priority_level varchar [note: 'Business priority assigned to the curative action based on drilling schedule, capital commitment, and operational impact. Critical priority typically indicates pre-drilling requirement.']
  recording_date date [note: 'Date when the curative instrument was officially recorded in the county land records office.']
  recording_reference varchar [note: 'Official recording reference number, book and page, or instrument number assigned by the county clerk when the curative document was recorded.']
  recording_required_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean indicator whether the curative instrument must be recorded in the county land records to perfect title. True indicates recording is required.']
  resolution_method varchar [note: 'Detailed explanation of the method used to resolve the title defect, including specific instruments executed, parties involved, and legal mechanisms employed.']
  resolution_notes varchar [note: 'Additional notes and commentary regarding the resolution of the curative action, including challenges encountered, alternative approaches considered, and lessons learned.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the operational system of record from which this curative action data originated (e.g., QUORUM for Quorum Land System).']

  Note: 'Transactional record tracking title curative actions required to resolve defects identified in title opinions before drilling or division order preparation. Captures curative type (missing heir affidavit, probate, correction deed, ratification, release of lien), assigned landman, due date, completion date, curative status, title opinion reference, and resolution notes. Curative management is a critical pre-drilling workflow ensuring marketable title before significant capital is committed.'
}

Table land.lease_obligation {
  lease_obligation_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the lease obligation record. Primary key for the lease obligation master record tracking all contractual obligations and critical dates associated with a lease.']
  afe_budget_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to procurement.afe_budget. Business justification: Lease obligations (delay rentals, shut-in payments) charged to AFEs. Existing afe_number is denormalized; replace with FK for proper cost allocation to capital projects.']
  employee_id varchar [note: 'System user identifier of the individual who approved the obligation satisfaction. Used for audit trail and segregation of duties compliance.']
  finance_afe_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.finance_afe. Business justification: Lease obligations (delay rentals, shut-in payments, surface damages) are charged to AFEs for proper cost allocation and working interest billing. Essential for JIB statement preparation and partner co']
  lease_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the parent lease agreement to which this obligation applies. Links the obligation to the master lease record.']
  obligation_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: Lease obligations (delay rentals, shut-in payments, surface damages) are compliance obligations tracked in compliance calendars. Required for obligation management, deadline tracking, and compliance r']
  operator_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the operating company responsible for satisfying this obligation. In joint venture arrangements, the operator manages lease obligations on behalf of all working interest owners.']
  venture_partner_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to venture.partner. Business justification: Lease obligations (delay rentals, shut-in payments) paid to venture partners. Venture_partner_id enables partner-level obligation tracking, AFE cost allocation, and JIB statement reconciliation.']
  well_asset_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the well associated with this obligation, applicable for shut-in royalty obligations, offset well requirements, or continuous drilling obligations. Links obligation to specific wellbore operations.']
  acreage_affected decimal(12,4) [note: 'Number of gross acres subject to this obligation. For delay rentals, this is the acreage covered by the rental payment; for Pugh clause obligations, this is the acreage at risk of release; for offset well obligations, this is the acreage requiring protection.']
  action_completion_date date [note: 'Date the required non-monetary action was completed. Used to verify compliance with continuous drilling clauses, offset well requirements, and other operational obligations. Null if action not yet completed.']
  action_required varchar [note: 'Description of the non-monetary action required to satisfy the obligation. Examples include: commence drilling operations, complete offset well, file regulatory report, execute lease extension, release acreage under Pugh clause, restore surface damage. Null for purely monetary obligations.']
  alert_notification_date date [note: 'Date when automated alert notification was sent to responsible parties regarding the upcoming obligation. Supports proactive obligation management and audit trail of notification workflows.']
  alert_recipient_email varchar [note: 'Email address of the land administrator or responsible party who received the obligation alert notification. Used for tracking notification delivery and escalation workflows.']
  approval_authority varchar [note: 'Name or title of the individual or committee with authority to approve satisfaction of this obligation. Used for internal controls and SOX compliance in expenditure authorization workflows.']
  approval_date date [note: 'Date the obligation payment or action was approved by the designated authority. Used for audit trail and internal control verification. Null if not yet approved.']
  cost_center_code varchar [note: 'Internal cost center code for financial accounting and reporting. Used to allocate obligation costs to appropriate organizational units in the ERP system.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this obligation record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the obligation amount. Supports multi-currency operations for international joint ventures and cross-border lease agreements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USD|CAD|GBP|EUR|MXN|BRL|NOK|AUD — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  due_date date [note: 'The date by which the obligation must be satisfied to maintain lease compliance. Critical for automated alert workflows and lease administration calendar. Missing this date may result in lease termination or regulatory violation.']
  gl_account_code varchar [note: 'General ledger account code for posting the obligation expense or liability. Ensures proper financial statement classification and compliance with petroleum accounting standards.']
  grace_period_days varchar [note: 'Number of days after the due date during which the obligation may be satisfied without lease termination or penalty. Varies by lease terms and state regulations. Null if no grace period applies.']
  jib_statement_number varchar [note: 'JIB statement number on which this obligation cost was billed to non-operating working interest partners. Used for joint venture cost recovery and partner reconciliation.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this obligation record was last updated. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization with source systems.']
  late_payment_penalty_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Monetary penalty assessed for late satisfaction of the obligation, if specified in the lease agreement. May be a flat fee or percentage of the obligation amount.']
  lease_termination_risk_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean indicator that failure to satisfy this obligation may result in automatic lease termination. True for critical obligations such as delay rentals during primary term, continuous drilling deadlines, and Pugh clause compliance dates. Triggers high-priority alerts.']
  net_revenue_interest_decimal decimal(10,8) [note: 'Net revenue interest percentage expressed as a decimal, representing the working interest after deducting royalty and overriding royalty burdens. Used to calculate net obligation impact on revenue distribution.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional context, special circumstances, dispute details, or resolution notes. Used by land administrators to document non-standard situations and provide audit trail commentary.']
  obligation_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Monetary value of the obligation if applicable. For delay rentals, this is the rental payment amount; for shut-in royalty, the royalty payment; for minimum royalty, the baseline payment. Null for non-monetary obligations such as drilling requirements or compliance actions.']
  obligation_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the obligation. Pending indicates future obligation not yet due; due indicates payment or action required; paid indicates completed payment; overdue indicates missed deadline with lease termination risk; waived indicates lessor forgiveness; cancelled indicates obligation no longer applicable; in dispute indicates contested terms; resolved indicates dispute settlement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|due|paid|overdue|waived|cancelled|in_dispute|resolved — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  obligation_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the contractual obligation. Delay rental payments maintain lease during primary term; shut-in royalty payments cover non-producing periods; minimum royalty ensures baseline lessor payments; offset well obligations require drilling to protect lease boundaries; lease extension payments exercise option terms; continuous drilling obligations maintain lease through active operations; Pugh clause compliance releases non-producing acreage; surface damage covers land restoration; environmental remediation addresses HSE requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: delay_rental|shut_in_royalty|minimum_royalty|offset_well|lease_extension_payment|continuous_drilling|pugh_clause_compliance|surface_damage|environmental_remediation|other — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  payee_tax_code varchar [note: 'Tax identification number for the payee, used for IRS 1099 reporting and tax compliance. Typically EIN for entities or SSN for individuals.']
  payment_date date [note: 'Actual date the obligation payment was made or the required action was completed. Used to track compliance history and calculate grace period violations. Null if obligation not yet satisfied.']
  payment_method varchar [note: 'Method used to satisfy the monetary obligation. Check indicates paper check payment; wire transfer indicates electronic funds transfer; ACH indicates automated clearing house; draft indicates bank draft; suspense release indicates payment from held funds; offset indicates credit against other obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: check|wire_transfer|ach|draft|suspense_release|offset|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  payment_reference_number varchar [note: 'External reference number for the payment transaction, such as check number, wire confirmation, or accounts payable voucher number. Used for audit trail and reconciliation with financial systems.']
  regulatory_agency varchar [note: 'Name of the regulatory agency to which filing or notification is required, such as BSEE, BOEM, state oil and gas commission, or county clerk. Null if no regulatory filing required.']
  regulatory_filing_date date [note: 'Date the required regulatory filing was submitted to the governing agency. Used to track compliance with state and federal reporting obligations. Null if no filing required or not yet submitted.']
  regulatory_filing_required_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean indicator that satisfaction of this obligation requires regulatory filing or notification. True for obligations involving lease amendments, acreage releases, or well commitments that must be reported to state or federal agencies.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the operational system of record from which this obligation data originated. QUORUM indicates Quorum Land System; SAP_JV indicates SAP Joint Venture Accounting; SAP_FI indicates SAP Financial Accounting; MANUAL indicates manual entry by land administrator; OTHER indicates alternative source.']
  well_api_number varchar [note: 'Standard API well number for the associated well, following the 10-14 digit format (state-county-unique well identifier). Used for regulatory reporting and cross-system well identification.']
  working_interest_decimal decimal(10,8) [note: 'Working interest ownership percentage expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.75000000 for 75% WI). Determines the operators share of obligation costs in joint venture arrangements. Used for AFE cost allocation.']

  Note: 'Master record tracking all contractual obligations and critical dates associated with a lease, serving as the unified obligation calendar for land administration. Covers obligation types including: delay rental payments (rental due dates, amounts, payment confirmation), shut-in royalty payments (shut-in periods, reasons, well references), lease expiration management (primary term expiry, extension options, HBP status, continuous drilling clauses, Pugh clause applicability), minimum royalty obligations, offset well obligations, and other contractual commitments. Captures obligation type, due date, amount or action required, compliance status, payment history, associated lease reference, and resolution/action taken. Proactive obligation management prevents inadvertent lease terminations and regulatory violations. Supports automated alert workflows for upcoming deadlines. Integrates with accounts payable for payment processing.'
}

Table land.shut_in_royalty {
  shut_in_royalty_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the shut-in royalty payment transaction record.']
  commercial_counterparty_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the operating company responsible for making the shut-in royalty payment and managing the well.']
  employee_id varchar [note: 'The system user identifier of the person who approved the shut-in royalty payment for disbursement.']
  finance_afe_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.finance_afe. Business justification: Shut-in royalty payments maintain lease rights when wells are temporarily non-producing. Costs are allocated to well AFEs for LOE tracking and working interest billing. Critical for lease maintenance ']
  lease_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the lease agreement under which the shut-in royalty obligation exists.']
  royalty_owner_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the mineral rights owner (lessor) receiving the shut-in royalty payment.']
  venture_partner_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to venture.partner. Business justification: Shut-in royalty payments to venture partners holding lease interests. Venture_partner_id enables partner-level payment tracking, JIB allocation, and compliance with JOA shut-in provisions.']
  well_asset_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the well that is shut in and capable of production but not currently producing.']
  acreage_covered decimal(12,4) [note: 'The net mineral acreage covered by this shut-in royalty payment, used in calculating the total payment amount.']
  approval_date date [note: 'The date when the shut-in royalty payment was approved by the authorized approver or land department.']
  consecutive_shut_in_months varchar [note: 'The cumulative number of consecutive months the well has been shut in under this shut-in royalty arrangement.']
  cost_center_code varchar [note: 'The internal cost center or business unit code to which the shut-in royalty expense is allocated.']
  gl_account_code varchar [note: 'The general ledger account code for recording the shut-in royalty expense in the financial system.']
  jib_statement_number varchar [note: 'The JIB statement number on which this shut-in royalty payment is billed to non-operating working interest owners.']
  lease_clause_reference varchar [note: 'Reference to the specific lease clause or paragraph that governs the shut-in royalty terms and conditions.']
  lease_maintenance_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this shut-in royalty payment successfully maintains the lease in force during the shut-in period, preventing lease expiration.']
  maximum_shut_in_duration_months varchar [note: 'The maximum number of consecutive months the well may remain shut in under shut-in royalty payments before the lease terminates, as specified in the lease agreement.']
  net_revenue_interest_decimal decimal(10,8) [note: 'The net revenue interest percentage (expressed as decimal) after royalty and other burdens, relevant to cost allocation.']
  payment_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The monetary amount of the shut-in royalty payment made to the lessor for the specified shut-in period.']
  payment_currency_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the shut-in royalty payment amount.']
  payment_date date [note: 'The actual date when the shut-in royalty payment was disbursed to the lessor.']
  payment_due_date date [note: 'The contractual date by which the shut-in royalty payment must be made to maintain the lease in force.']
  payment_method varchar [note: 'The disbursement method used to deliver the shut-in royalty payment to the lessor.']
  payment_notes varchar [note: 'Free-form notes or comments regarding special circumstances, adjustments, or issues related to this shut-in royalty payment.']
  payment_number varchar [note: 'Business identifier for the shut-in royalty payment transaction, used for tracking and reconciliation.']
  payment_rate_per_acre decimal(12,2) [note: 'The per-acre rate used to calculate the shut-in royalty payment, as specified in the lease agreement.']
  payment_reference_number varchar [note: 'External reference number from the payment system (check number, wire confirmation, ACH trace number) for reconciliation.']
  payment_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the shut-in royalty payment in the approval and disbursement workflow.']
  production_capability_verification_date date [note: 'The date when the wells production capability was last verified through testing or production history.']
  production_capability_verified_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the wells capability to produce in paying quantities has been verified, a requirement for valid shut-in royalty payments under most lease terms.']
  record_created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this shut-in royalty payment record was first created in the system.']
  record_status varchar [note: 'The current data lifecycle status of this shut-in royalty payment record in the data warehouse.']
  record_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this shut-in royalty payment record was last modified in the system.']
  shut_in_period_end_date date [note: 'The date when the shut-in period ended, either through resumption of production or lease termination.']
  shut_in_period_start_date date [note: 'The date when the well was shut in and ceased production, marking the beginning of the shut-in royalty obligation period.']
  shut_in_reason_code varchar [note: 'Categorical code indicating the primary reason the well is shut in and not producing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: lack_of_market|no_pipeline|mechanical_failure|regulatory_restriction|economic|weather|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  shut_in_reason_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative explanation of the specific circumstances causing the well to be shut in during this period.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Identifier of the source system from which this shut-in royalty payment record originated (e.g., Quorum, SAP JV Accounting).']
  well_api_number varchar [note: 'The standardized API well number for the shut-in well, providing regulatory identification.']
  well_name varchar [note: 'The business name or designation of the shut-in well for operational reference.']
  working_interest_decimal decimal(10,8) [note: 'The working interest ownership percentage (expressed as decimal) of the operator or party responsible for the shut-in royalty payment.']

  Note: 'Transactional record for shut-in royalty payments made to lessors when a well capable of production is shut in (not producing) due to lack of market, pipeline connection, or other operational reasons. Captures shut-in period, payment amount, payment date, shut-in reason, well reference, lease reference, and whether the shut-in royalty maintains the lease in force. Shut-in royalty provisions are a critical lease maintenance mechanism when production ceases temporarily.'
}

Table land.leasing_prospect {
  leasing_prospect_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for leasing_prospect']

The business actively manages unit participation through unit operating agreements, participation schedules maintained in land systems, and detailed allocation factors used by revenue accounting and joint interest billing systems. This is a recognized operational relationship with contractual, regulatory, and financial significance.'

  Note: 'This association product represents the operational assignment of specific tracts to oil and gas leases. Each record links one lease to one tract with acreage allocations, interest percentages, and effective dates that exist only in the context of this specific lease-tract combination.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas land administration, leases routinely cover multiple non-contiguous tracts (a single lease agreement can span dozens of tracts across a field), and tracts are frequently included in multiple leases simultaneously due to depth severance (stacked leases at different depths), split mineral rights (separate oil vs gas leases), or overlapping lease periods during transitions. Land departments actively manage lease-tract assignments through acreage schedules, tract participation records, and amendment tracking, with specific acreage allocations, interest percentages, and effective dates maintained for each lease-tract combination.'
}

Table land.lease_interest {
  lease_interest_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each working interest position record. Primary key for the lease_interest association.']
  customer_counterparty_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the counterparty holding the working interest position in this lease. Identifies the party (IOC, NOC, independent operator, or working interest owner) with ownership stake and revenue entitlement.']
  lease_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the oil and gas lease in which the counterparty holds a working interest position. Identifies the specific mineral rights agreement subject to joint ownership.']
  acquisition_method varchar [note: 'Method by which this counterparty acquired their working interest position. Original lease indicates they were a party to the initial lease agreement. Farm-in indicates they earned interest through drilling or development obligations. Assignment indicates purchase from another working interest owner. Used for audit trail and title verification.']
  cost_bearing_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this counterparty bears their proportionate share of lease operating costs and capital expenditures. In some carried interest arrangements, a party may hold working interest without bearing costs during initial development. Used for joint interest billing (JIB) and AFE cost allocation.']
  created_date timestamp [note: 'System timestamp when this lease interest record was created in the land system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date when this counterparty\'s working interest position became effective. Marks the start of their ownership stake, cost-bearing obligations, and revenue entitlement. Critical for production allocation and royalty calculation temporal logic.']
  interest_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the type of interest held by this counterparty in the lease. Distinguishes between standard working interest (cost-bearing ownership), overriding royalty interest (revenue share without costs), carried interest (non-cost-bearing during payout), and back-in interest (contingent future interest after payout). Determines cost allocation and revenue distribution treatment.']
  net_revenue_interest_percent decimal(7,4) [note: 'Percentage of production revenue this counterparty receives after deducting royalties, overriding royalties, and other burdens from their working interest. Calculated as working_interest_percent minus all revenue deductions. Used for production allocation and revenue distribution.']
  operator_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this counterparty is designated as the operator of the lease. The operator is responsible for day-to-day operations, drilling, production, and regulatory compliance. Typically only one working interest owner per lease has operator_flag = true.']
  overriding_royalty_interest_percent decimal(5,4) [note: 'Percentage of production revenue carved out of the working interest and paid to a third party. Does not bear operating costs. [Moved from lease: This attribute currently exists in the lease product but represents a specific party\'s ORRI carve-out, not a lease-level aggregate. Multiple parties may hold different ORRI percentages in the same lease. This attribute belongs in the lease_interest association to support multiple ORRI holders per lease.]']
  payout_status varchar [note: 'Indicates whether this working interest position has reached payout (recovery of capital costs). Pre-payout indicates the counterparty is still recovering their investment. Post-payout indicates capital has been recovered and different revenue sharing terms may apply. Relevant for carried interest and back-in interest arrangements.']
  termination_date date [note: 'Date when this counterparty\'s working interest position terminated due to sale, assignment, or lease expiration. Null indicates the interest is currently active. Used to track historical ownership changes and calculate revenue entitlement periods.']
  updated_date timestamp [note: 'System timestamp when this lease interest record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data synchronization with downstream systems (royalty, JIB, production allocation).']
  working_interest_percent decimal(7,4) [note: 'Percentage ownership of the operating rights and cost-bearing obligations in the lease held by this counterparty. Represents the party\'s share of capital expenditures, operating expenses, and gross production. Sum of all working interests in a lease typically equals 100%.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the Working Interest Position between customer_counterparty and lease. It captures the joint operating agreement terms that define each counterparty\'s ownership stake, revenue entitlement, and operational responsibilities in a specific oil and gas lease. Each record links one customer_counterparty to one lease with attributes that exist only in the context of this co-ownership relationship, including working interest percentage, net revenue interest, operator designation, and cost-bearing obligations.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas joint ventures, multiple counterparties (IOCs, NOCs, independent operators) routinely hold simultaneous working interest positions in a single lease, and each counterparty typically holds interests across a portfolio of multiple leases. The business actively manages these working interest positions as operational records with specific attributes (working interest %, net revenue interest %, operator designation, effective dates) that belong to neither the counterparty nor the lease alone, but to the specific counterparty-lease combination. This is the core business concept of \'Lease Interest\' or \'Working Interest Position\' tracked in land systems and consumed by royalty, JIB, and production allocation processes.'
}

Table venture.cash_call_payment {

  netting_applied_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether partner netting was applied to offset this payment against amounts owed by the operator to the partner. True when payment is reduced by bilateral netting.']

  payment_amount_base_currency decimal(18,2) [note: 'The payment amount converted to the operators base reporting currency using the exchange rate. Used for consolidated financial reporting and variance analysis.']
  payment_confirmation_sent_date date [note: 'The date on which the operator sent payment confirmation or receipt acknowledgment to the partner. Used for partner communication tracking.']
  payment_currency varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the payment was received. May differ from the cash call currency if partner pays in alternate currency.']
  payment_date date [note: 'The date on which the partner payment was received by the operator. Used to calculate late payment interest per Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) terms.']
  payment_method varchar [note: 'The financial instrument or mechanism used by the partner to remit payment. Offset indicates payment via partner netting or cost recovery allocation.']
  payment_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes or comments regarding this payment. May include partner explanations for variances, dispute details, or special payment arrangements.']
  payment_reference_number varchar [note: 'External payment reference number or transaction identifier provided by the paying partner or their bank. Used for reconciliation and audit trail.']
  receiving_bank_account varchar [note: 'The operators bank account number into which this payment was deposited. Used to reconcile bank statements with cash call collections.']
  reconciled_by varchar [note: 'The name or identifier of the joint venture accountant who performed the reconciliation. Used for audit trail and accountability.']
  reconciliation_date date [note: 'The date on which the payment was reconciled against the cash call and variance was resolved or accepted. Null if reconciliation is still pending.']
  reconciliation_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the payment reconciliation against the called amount. Underpaid and overpaid statuses trigger follow-up actions per JOA terms. Disputed indicates partner has challenged the cash call.']
  variance_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The difference between called amount and payment amount in base currency. Positive indicates overpayment, negative indicates underpayment. Triggers default interest calculation if negative.']
  created_by varchar [note: 'The user identifier or name of the person who created this payment record. Used for audit trail and accountability.']

  Note: 'Records each partner\'s actual payment response to a cash call, capturing payment date, amount received, payment method, bank reference, currency, exchange rate applied, and reconciliation status against the called amount. Enables operator to identify underpayments, overpayments, and late payments triggering default interest under the JOA. Links to partner netting records.'
}

  settlement_method varchar [note: 'The method by which the imbalance will be settled: in-kind (through future production adjustments), cash (monetary settlement), hybrid (combination of in-kind and cash), or not applicable (no settlement required).']
  source_system varchar [note: 'The name of the source system from which this imbalance record was extracted, typically SAP Joint Venture Accounting or Avocet Production Operations.']
  tolerance_threshold_boe decimal(18,3) [note: 'The maximum allowable imbalance volume in barrels of oil equivalent before settlement is required, as defined in the JOA or PSA.']
  tolerance_threshold_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'The maximum allowable imbalance as a percentage of entitled volume before settlement is required, as defined in the JOA or PSA.']
  working_interest_percentage decimal(7,4) [note: 'The partners working interest percentage in the asset at the time of the imbalance calculation, used to determine entitled volumes.']

  Note: 'Tracks cumulative overlift and underlift imbalance positions per partner per JOA/PSA asset. Captures opening balance, current period lifting variance, cumulative imbalance volume (BOE), imbalance value at reference price, settlement method (cash or in-kind), and settlement status. Enables equalization calculations and supports partner dispute resolution for production imbalances.'
}

Captures committee name, associated JOA, meeting frequency, quorum requirements, voting threshold for ordinary vs. special resolutions, and current chairperson. SSOT for JOA governance structure.'

Table venture.carried_interest {
  carried_interest_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the carried interest arrangement. Primary key.']
  afe_budget_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to procurement.afe_budget. Business justification: Carried interest arrangements track costs against specific AFE budgets for recovery calculations and payout determination. Essential for farmout economics and partner cost recovery in oil-and-gas join']
  drilling_afe_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the AFE document that authorizes the expenditures covered by this carried interest arrangement.']
  joa_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the joint operating agreement under which this carried interest arrangement is established.']
  lease_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to land.lease. Business justification: Carry agreements are tied to specific lease interests. Lease_id defines the scope of carry, enables tracking of carried costs by lease, and determines reversion working interest upon payout.']
  primary_carried_carrier_partner_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the partner who is funding the carried party\'s share of costs during the carry period.']
  psa_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the production sharing agreement if this carried interest is part of a PSA structure. Nullable for JOA-only arrangements.']
  wbs_element_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Carried interest tracking requires WBS elements for cost accumulation, recovery monitoring, and payout calculation. Critical for farmout economics tracking and carried party cost recovery reporting.']
  well_asset_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the specific asset (well, field, lease, or facility) to which this carried interest arrangement applies.']
  accrued_interest_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total interest amount in base currency that has accrued on the outstanding carry balance to date.']
  back_in_right_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the carried party has the right to back-in to the project after payout by reimbursing the carrier for carried costs.']
  back_in_wi_percentage decimal(7,4) [note: 'Working interest percentage the carried party can back-in to if they exercise their back-in right. Nullable if no back-in right exists.']
  carried_interest_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the carried interest arrangement.']
  carried_wi_percentage decimal(7,4) [note: 'The working interest percentage of the carried party that is being carried by the carrier partner.']
  carry_agreement_number varchar [note: 'Business identifier for the carried interest arrangement, typically referenced in AFE documents and joint interest billing.']
  carry_amount_limit decimal(18,2) [note: 'Maximum amount in base currency that the carrier will fund on behalf of the carried party. Nullable for unlimited carry arrangements.']
  carry_phase varchar [note: 'The operational phase during which the carry applies: exploration, appraisal, development, drilling, or completion.']
  carry_type varchar [note: 'Type of carry arrangement: full (100% of costs carried), partial (percentage of costs carried), casing_point (carry until casing point decision), or production (carry until first production).']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this carried interest record was first created in the system.']
  cumulative_carried_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total amount in base currency that has been carried by the carrier partner to date, including all costs funded on behalf of the carried party.']
  cumulative_recovered_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total amount in base currency that has been recovered by the carrier partner to date through the agreed recovery mechanism.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this carried interest arrangement.']
  default_provision varchar [note: 'Contractual provisions that apply if the carried party defaults on obligations or if the carrier fails to fund agreed costs.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date when the carried interest arrangement becomes effective and cost carrying begins.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'Date when the carried interest arrangement expires or the carry period ends. Nullable for open-ended arrangements.']
  forfeiture_provision varchar [note: 'Terms under which the carried party may forfeit their interest if they fail to meet obligations or if recovery conditions are not met.']
  interest_accrual_method varchar [note: 'Method of interest calculation on the outstanding carry balance: simple (interest on principal only), compound (interest on principal plus accrued interest), or none (no interest).']
  interest_rate_percentage decimal(7,4) [note: 'Annual interest rate applied to the outstanding carry balance if the carry agreement includes interest accrual. Nullable if no interest applies.']
  modified_by varchar [note: 'User identifier of the person who last modified this carried interest record.']
  modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this carried interest record was last modified in the system.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-form text field for additional comments, special terms, or clarifications regarding the carried interest arrangement.']
  outstanding_carry_balance decimal(18,2) [note: 'Current outstanding balance in base currency that remains to be recovered by the carrier partner. Calculated as cumulative_carried_amount minus cumulative_recovered_amount.']
  payout_date date [note: 'Date when the carried interest was fully recovered and payout was achieved. Nullable until payout is complete.']
  payout_status varchar [note: 'Current payout status of the carry arrangement: pre_payout (no recovery started), in_payout (recovery in progress), post_payout (fully recovered), or suspended (recovery temporarily halted).']
  recovery_mechanism varchar [note: 'Method by which the carrier recovers carried costs: gross_revenue (from gross production revenue), net_revenue (from net revenue after royalties), production_volume (from carried party\'s production volumes), or cost_allocation (through future cost allocations).']
  recovery_multiplier decimal(5,2) [note: 'Multiplier applied to carried costs for recovery calculation. For example, 2.0 means carrier recovers twice the carried amount. Default is 1.0 for dollar-for-dollar recovery.']
  recovery_rate_percentage decimal(7,4) [note: 'Percentage of the carried party\'s revenue or production that is applied to recover the carried costs. For example, 50% means half of carried party\'s revenue goes to carrier until carry is recovered.']
  reversion_nri_percentage decimal(7,4) [note: 'Net revenue interest percentage that reverts to the carrier partner after payout is achieved. Nullable if no reversion applies.']
  reversion_wi_percentage decimal(7,4) [note: 'Working interest percentage that reverts to the carrier partner after payout is achieved. Nullable if no reversion applies.']
  sec_disclosure_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this carried interest arrangement must be disclosed in SEC filings due to materiality thresholds or partner reporting requirements.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Name of the source system from which this carried interest record originated, typically SAP Joint Venture Accounting or partner accounting system.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Unique identifier for this carried interest record in the source system, used for data lineage and reconciliation.']
  created_by varchar [note: 'User identifier of the person who created this carried interest record.']

  Note: 'Tracks carried interest arrangements where one partner (the carrier) funds another partner\'s (the carried party) share of costs during an exploration or development phase, to be recovered from future production revenues. Captures carry type (full/partial), carry period, carry amount, recovery mechanism (gross/net), recovery rate, cumulative recovered amount, and outstanding carry balance. Supports complex E&P financing structures.'
}

Table venture.state_participation {
  state_participation_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the state participation record. Primary key.']
  concession_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the concession agreement under which this state participation is granted, if applicable.']

  afe_approval_threshold_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'The minimum AFE amount (in USD) that requires approval from the state participation interest holder. Null if no approval rights or no threshold applies.']
  back_in_right_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this participation is a back-in right (True) or an immediate participation (False). Back-in rights allow the government to acquire interest after a discovery or milestone.']

  cost_recovery_eligible_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the state participation interest is eligible to recover historical exploration and development costs from cost oil/gas under the PSA. True if eligible, False if the state enters with no cost recovery rights (typical for free carry).']
  cost_recovery_limit_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'The maximum cumulative amount of historical costs that the state may recover from its share of cost oil/gas, expressed in USD. Null if no limit applies or if cost recovery is not permitted.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this state participation record was first created in the system.']
  effective_date date [note: 'The date from which the state participation becomes effective for cost recovery, entitlement, and revenue sharing purposes.']
  entitlement_calculation_method varchar [note: 'The method used to calculate the states production entitlement under this participation: working interest (proportionate share of gross production), profit oil split (share of profit oil/gas after cost recovery), net revenue interest (share of net revenue), hybrid (combination of methods), or other.']
  exercise_date date [note: 'The date on which the host government formally exercised its participation right by notifying the operator or consortium.']
  exercise_deadline_date date [note: 'The contractual deadline by which the host government must notify the operator of its intent to exercise the participation right. Null if no deadline applies.']
  exercise_trigger_event varchar [note: 'The contractual event or milestone that enables or requires the host government to exercise its participation right: commercial discovery, final investment decision (FID), first production, development plan approval, reserves booking, field declaration, production threshold, or cumulative production milestone. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commercial discovery|final investment decision|first production|development plan approval|reserves booking|field declaration|production threshold|cumulative production milestone — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  expiry_date date [note: 'The date on which the state participation arrangement expires or terminates, if applicable. Null for indefinite participation.']
  host_government_entity_code varchar [note: 'Reference to the host government or National Oil Company (NOC) exercising the participation right.']
  modified_by varchar [note: 'The user ID or name of the person who last modified this state participation record.']
  modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this state participation record was last modified in the system.']
  non_consent_option_available_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the state participation interest holder has the right to elect non-consent on discretionary operations under the JOA. True if non-consent is available, False if the state must participate in all approved operations.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional comments, special terms, or clarifications regarding the state participation arrangement.']
  operator_consent_date date [note: 'The date on which the operator or JOA partners formally consented to the state participation, if consent was required.']
  operator_consent_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the operator or other JOA partners must consent to the state exercising its participation right. True if consent is required, False if the right is automatic upon exercise.']
  participation_number varchar [note: 'Business identifier for the state participation arrangement, typically assigned by the operator or regulatory authority.']
  participation_percentage decimal(10,6) [note: 'The percentage of working interest that the host government or NOC holds or may acquire under this participation arrangement. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 15.000000 for 15%).']
  participation_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the state participation: pending (right exists but not yet exercised), exercised (government has elected to participate), active (participation is in effect), expired (option period lapsed), waived (government declined to exercise), or terminated (participation ended).']
  participation_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the state participation mechanism: back-in right (government option to acquire interest post-discovery), free carry (government interest with no cost obligation), paid participation (government pays proportionate share), carried interest (costs recovered from production), state equity (direct ownership), or royalty participation (in-kind royalty converted to equity).']
  profit_gas_split_percentage decimal(10,6) [note: 'The percentage of profit gas allocated to the state under this participation arrangement, if different from the standard PSA profit gas split. Null if standard PSA terms apply.']
  profit_oil_split_percentage decimal(10,6) [note: 'The percentage of profit oil allocated to the state under this participation arrangement, if different from the standard PSA profit oil split. Null if standard PSA terms apply.']
  regulatory_approval_date date [note: 'The date on which the relevant regulatory authority approved the state participation, if approval was required.']
  regulatory_approval_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether regulatory or ministerial approval is required to formalize the state participation. True if approval is required, False if the participation is self-executing under the PSA.']
  reversion_trigger_event varchar [note: 'The event that triggers reversion of additional working interest to the state: payout, cumulative production milestone, contract expiry, field abandonment, reserves depletion, or none if no reversion applies.']
  reversion_wi_percentage decimal(10,6) [note: 'The working interest percentage that reverts to the state after payout or at a specified milestone, if applicable. Null if no reversion clause exists.']
  sec_disclosure_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this state participation arrangement must be disclosed in SEC filings due to materiality or impact on reserves and entitlements. True if disclosure is required, False otherwise.']
  termination_date date [note: 'The date on which the state participation was terminated, if applicable. Null if the participation is still active or pending.']
  termination_reason varchar [note: 'Free-text explanation of why the state participation was terminated (e.g., contract expiry, government waiver, field abandonment, regulatory change).']
  trigger_date date [note: 'The date on which the trigger event occurred, initiating the governments right or obligation to participate.']
  created_by varchar [note: 'The user ID or name of the person who created this state participation record.']

  Note: 'Tracks the host government or NOC\'s back-in or carried participation rights under a PSA or concession agreement. Captures participation type (back-in right, free carry, paid participation), participation percentage, exercise trigger (discovery, FID, production), exercise date, consideration paid, and current participation status. Supports PSA entitlement calculations and SEC disclosure of government participation terms.'

  interest_rate_late_payment_pct decimal(5,3) [note: 'Annual interest rate applied to late or overdue royalty payments, expressed as a percentage.']

  last_payment_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent royalty payment made to the payee.']

  payee_tax_code varchar [note: 'Tax identification number of the payee for IRS 1099 reporting and withholding compliance.']

  payout_status varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the obligation is subject to payout provisions and current payout state: not applicable (no payout clause), pre-payout (costs not yet recovered), or post-payout (costs recovered, full royalty rate applies).']
  production_basis varchar [note: 'Defines whether royalty is calculated on gross production (before any deductions), net production (after operating costs), working interest share, or net revenue interest share.']
  royalty_obligation_number varchar [note: 'Business identifier for the royalty obligation, used for external communication and reporting.']
  royalty_obligation_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the royalty obligation: active (accruing and payable), suspended (temporarily halted), terminated (ended), pending approval (awaiting contract execution), disputed (under legal review), or paid out (obligation fully satisfied).']
  royalty_rate_percent decimal(10,6) [note: 'Fixed royalty rate expressed as a percentage of production value or volume. Null if sliding scale or tiered structure applies.']
  royalty_subtype varchar [note: 'Further classification or variant of the royalty type, capturing jurisdiction-specific or contract-specific nuances.']
  royalty_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the royalty obligation. Gross overriding royalty interest (ORRI) is paid from gross production before costs; net profits interest (NPI) is paid after cost recovery; government royalty is owed to state or federal authorities; landowner royalty is owed to mineral rights owners; production payment is a fixed-volume or fixed-value obligation; carried interest royalty is owed when a carried party begins paying.']
  sap_jva_document_number varchar [note: 'SAP Joint Venture Accounting system document number for this royalty obligation, used for integration and reconciliation.']
  sec_disclosure_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this royalty obligation must be disclosed in SEC filings due to materiality or partner relationship (True/False).']
  sliding_scale_basis varchar [note: 'The metric on which the sliding scale royalty rate is calculated: production volume thresholds, commodity price tiers, cumulative recovery milestones, or time-based phases.']
  sliding_scale_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the royalty rate varies based on production volume, price, or cumulative recovery (True/False).']
  suspension_reason varchar [note: 'Explanation for suspension of royalty payments: production shut-in, force majeure, payee dispute, regulatory hold, or other cause.']
  termination_date date [note: 'Actual date on which the royalty obligation was terminated, if applicable.']
  termination_reason varchar [note: 'Reason for termination of the royalty obligation: lease expiration, asset abandonment, buyout, mutual agreement, or contract breach.']
  created_by varchar [note: 'User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this record.']

  Note: 'Master record for royalty obligations owed to mineral rights owners, governments, or overriding royalty interest holders under lease, JOA, or PSA terms. Captures royalty type (gross overriding, net profits interest, government royalty), royalty rate or sliding scale tiers, production basis (gross/net), payment frequency, payee details, and applicable deductions. Distinct from the land domain\'s lease royalty — this entity tracks the venture-level royalty obligation and payment status.'
}
