  currency_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the default amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).']
  default_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Monetary value of the default obligation in the specified currency. For cash call defaults, this is the unpaid amount. For work program failures, this may represent the estimated cost of unperformed work.']
  default_interest_rate_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Annual interest rate percentage applied to unpaid default amounts as specified in the JOA default provisions.']
  default_notice_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known unique business identifier for the default notice document, typically assigned by the operator.']
  default_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the default notice. Notice issued indicates formal notice has been sent. Cure period active indicates partner has time remaining to remedy default. Cured indicates partner has remedied the default. Forfeited indicates partner interest has been forfeited per JOA provisions. Negotiated settlement indicates parties reached alternative resolution. Litigation indicates dispute escalated to legal proceedings. Withdrawn indicates notice was retracted by operator. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: notice_issued|cure_period_active|cured|forfeited|negotiated_settlement|litigation|withdrawn — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  default_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the default event. Cash call non-payment indicates failure to remit funds by due date. AFE non-consent indicates partner elected not to participate in approved expenditure. Work program failure indicates failure to perform committed work obligations. Insurance non-compliance indicates failure to maintain required insurance coverage. Abandonment obligation failure indicates failure to fund plugging and abandonment obligations.']
  forfeited_nri_pct decimal(7,4) [note: 'Actual percentage of net revenue interest forfeited from the defaulting partner as a result of uncured default.']
  forfeited_wi_pct decimal(7,4) [note: 'Actual percentage of working interest forfeited from the defaulting partner as a result of uncured default.']
  forfeiture_date date [note: 'Date on which the defaulting partner\'s working interest was formally forfeited to non-defaulting partners per JOA provisions.']
  forfeiture_risk_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the defaulting partner\'s working interest is at risk of forfeiture under JOA default provisions. True if forfeiture is possible, false otherwise.']
  joa_default_clause_reference varchar [note: 'Specific article, section, or clause number in the JOA that governs this default and the remedies being pursued.']
  legal_action_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the default has escalated to formal legal proceedings, arbitration, or litigation. True if legal action initiated, false otherwise.']
  legal_case_reference varchar [note: 'Court case number, arbitration reference, or other legal proceeding identifier if the default has escalated to formal dispute resolution.']
  modified_by varchar [note: 'User identifier or name of the person who last modified this default notice record in the system.']
  modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this default notice record was last modified or updated in the system.']
  non_defaulting_partners_notified_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether all non-defaulting partners have been formally notified of the default per JOA requirements. True if notified, false otherwise.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional context, communications history, or special circumstances related to the default notice and resolution process.']
  notice_delivery_method varchar [note: 'Method by which the default notice was formally delivered to the defaulting partner as required by JOA notice provisions.']
  notice_document_reference varchar [note: 'Document management system reference or file path to the formal default notice letter or document sent to the defaulting partner.']
  notice_issue_date date [note: 'Date on which the formal default notice was issued to the defaulting partner by the operator.']
  nri_at_risk_pct decimal(7,4) [note: 'Percentage of net revenue interest held by the defaulting partner that is subject to potential forfeiture if the default is not cured.']
  opcom_review_date date [note: 'Date on which the default was reviewed or is scheduled to be reviewed by the joint venture operating committee.']
  settlement_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total monetary amount agreed in the negotiated settlement, which may differ from the original default amount plus interest.']
  settlement_date date [note: 'Date on which a negotiated settlement agreement was reached between the operator and defaulting partner as an alternative to forfeiture.']
  settlement_terms varchar [note: 'Summary of the negotiated settlement terms agreed between parties, including payment schedules, interest concessions, or work program modifications.']
  wi_at_risk_pct decimal(7,4) [note: 'Percentage of working interest held by the defaulting partner that is subject to potential forfeiture if the default is not cured.']
  created_by varchar [note: 'User identifier or name of the person who created this default notice record in the system.']

  Note: 'Records formal default notices issued to non-paying or non-performing partners under JOA default provisions. Captures defaulting partner, default type (cash call non-payment, AFE non-consent, work program failure), notice date, cure period, default amount, forfeiture risk, and resolution status. Tracks the full default lifecycle from notice through cure, forfeiture, or negotiated settlement.'
}

Table venture.non_consent_election {
  non_consent_election_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the non-consent election record. Primary key for tracking a partner\'s decision to go non-consent on a proposed Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) operation.']
  afe_budget_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to procurement.afe_budget. Business justification: Non-consent elections reference the AFE budget being declined, essential for penalty calculations, recoupment tracking, and working interest adjustments. Core to JOA non-consent provisions and partner']
  asset_facility_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the facility asset associated with the non-consent operation, if applicable. Null for well-specific operations.']
  compliance_regulatory_filing_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Non-consent elections affecting working interests must be disclosed in SEC reserve filings when material. Changes in proved reserves due to non-consent forfeitures require regulatory disclosure under ']
  drilling_afe_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the AFE that triggered the non-consent election. The AFE describes the proposed operation (well, workover, facility) that the partner declined to participate in.']
  employee_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the user or system account that approved the non-consent election record. Supports audit trail and governance requirements.']
  joa_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the Joint Operating Agreement under which this non-consent election is made. Links to the governing JOA that defines non-consent provisions and penalty terms.']
  lease_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to land.lease. Business justification: Non-consent elections forfeit working interest in specific lease operations. Lease_id is core to penalty calculation, interest reversion tracking, and division order updates post-payout.']
  primary_non_electing_partner_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the joint venture partner who elected to go non-consent. This partner forfeits participation rights in exchange for avoiding upfront capital exposure.']
  well_asset_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the well asset associated with the non-consent operation, if applicable. Null for facility-level or non-well operations.']
  approval_date date [note: 'Date on which the operator or operating committee formally approved and recorded the non-consent election. Establishes the official start of non-consent provisions.']
  back_in_right_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the non-consenting partner retains a back-in right to resume participation after payout or other trigger event. True if back-in provisions exist in the JOA.']
  back_in_trigger_event varchar [note: 'Description of the event or condition that triggers the non-consenting partner\'s back-in right, if applicable. Examples include payout achievement, production threshold, or time-based milestone.']
  cancellation_date date [note: 'Date on which the non-consent election was cancelled or voided, if applicable. Occurs when the operation is abandoned or the partner reverses their election within allowed timeframes.']
  cancellation_reason varchar [note: 'Explanation for why the non-consent election was cancelled. Examples include operation abandonment, partner withdrawal reversal, or JOA amendment.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this non-consent election record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this non-consent election record. Ensures consistent financial reporting across international joint ventures. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USD|CAD|GBP|EUR|AUD|NOK|BRL|MXN — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  election_date date [note: 'Date on which the partner formally elected to go non-consent. This date establishes the partner\'s forfeiture of participation rights and triggers penalty provisions.']
  election_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the non-consent election. Tracks progression from initial election through recoupment and potential reinstatement.']
  jib_allocation_method varchar [note: 'Method used to allocate production revenue for recoupment purposes in joint interest billing statements. Defines how revenue is distributed between consenting and non-consenting partners during the penalty period.']
  modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this non-consent election record was last modified. Tracks the most recent update for audit and reconciliation purposes.']
  non_consent_penalty_multiplier decimal(6,2) [note: 'Penalty multiplier applied to the non-consenting partner\'s share of operation costs. Typical values range from 200% to 500%, with 300% being common. Defines the total recoupment amount consenting partners must recover before reinstating the non-consenting partner.']
  non_consent_share_cost decimal(18,2) [note: 'The non-consenting partner\'s proportionate share of the operation cost based on their working interest. This is the base amount before penalty multiplier is applied.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional comments, clarifications, or special conditions related to the non-consent election. Captures context not covered by structured fields.']
  nri_forfeited_percent decimal(10,6) [note: 'Percentage of net revenue interest forfeited by the non-consenting partner during the recoupment period. Reflects the revenue share temporarily transferred to consenting partners.']
  operation_cost_estimate decimal(18,2) [note: 'Estimated total cost of the operation subject to non-consent, as stated in the AFE. Used to calculate the non-consenting partner\'s share and penalty obligation.']
  operation_type varchar [note: 'Type of JOA operation subject to the non-consent election. Defines the nature of the capital project the partner declined to fund.']
  penalty_recoupment_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total amount that must be recouped by consenting partners before the non-consenting partner is reinstated. Calculated as non_consent_share_cost multiplied by non_consent_penalty_multiplier.']
  recouped_amount_to_date decimal(18,2) [note: 'Cumulative amount recouped by consenting partners from production revenue as of the current date. Tracks progress toward full penalty recovery and partner reinstatement.']
  recoupment_completion_date date [note: 'Date on which consenting partners fully recovered the penalty recoupment amount. Triggers reinstatement of the non-consenting partner\'s working interest.']
  recoupment_start_date date [note: 'Date on which recoupment of the non-consent penalty began. Typically coincides with first production or revenue allocation from the operation.']
  reinstatement_date date [note: 'Date on which the non-consenting partner\'s working interest and net revenue interest were reinstated following full penalty recoupment. Partner resumes normal participation rights.']
  reinstatement_status varchar [note: 'Status of the non-consenting partner\'s reinstatement to full working interest participation. Indicates whether penalty has been fully recouped and rights restored.']
  remaining_recoupment_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Outstanding balance of penalty recoupment amount that consenting partners have yet to recover. Calculated as penalty_recoupment_amount minus recouped_amount_to_date.']
  sec_disclosure_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this non-consent election must be disclosed in SEC filings due to materiality thresholds or partner reporting obligations. True if SEC disclosure is required.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Name of the source system from which this non-consent election record originated. Typically SAP Joint Venture Accounting or similar JV management system.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Unique identifier of this non-consent election record in the source system. Enables traceability and reconciliation back to the system of record.']
  wi_forfeited_percent decimal(10,6) [note: 'Percentage of working interest forfeited by the non-consenting partner during the recoupment period. This interest reverts to consenting partners until the non-consent penalty is recovered.']

  Note: 'Records a partner\'s election to go non-consent on a proposed JOA operation (well, workover, facility), forfeiting their right to participate in exchange for a non-consent penalty premium on future production. Captures electing partner, operation reference, non-consent date, non-consent penalty multiplier (e.g., 300% recoupment), recouped amount to date, and reinstatement status. Supports JOA non-consent accounting under COPAS.'
}

  cost_center_code varchar [note: 'The accounting cost center code used for joint interest billing of costs from this contract allocation. Enables proper cost tracking and reporting in the operator\'s accounting system and partner billing statements.']
  cost_recovery_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether costs from this contract allocation are eligible for cost recovery under the JOA terms and applicable Production Sharing Contract or other upstream agreements. False indicates non-recoverable costs that must be borne by working interest partners without reimbursement from production revenue.']
  created_date timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this contract allocation record was created in the system.']
  effective_date date [note: 'The date when this contract allocation to the JOA becomes effective. May differ from the contract\'s overall effective date if the contract is added to the JOA mid-term or if allocation percentages change over time.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'The date when this contract allocation to the JOA expires or terminates. Nullable if the allocation continues for the full contract term. Used to track changes in contract allocation over time as JOAs are amended or assets are transferred.']
  last_modified_date timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this contract allocation record was last modified, including changes to allocation percentage, billing method, or status.']
  overhead_rate decimal(10,4) [note: 'The overhead rate applied to this contract allocation for this specific JOA, which may differ from the JOA\'s standard overhead rate based on contract type or negotiated terms. Used to calculate overhead charges in joint interest billing.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the allocation of procurement contracts (including rig contracts and master service agreements) to Joint Operating Agreements. In joint venture operations, a single procurement contract often serves multiple JOAs simultaneously, and each JOA may utilize multiple contracts. Each record captures the allocation percentage, billing method, cost recovery eligibility, and overhead rate specific to each JOA-contract pairing, enabling accurate cost allocation and joint interest billing across working interest partners.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas joint venture operations, procurement contracts (especially rig contracts and master service agreements) routinely serve multiple Joint Operating Agreements simultaneously, and each JOA utilizes multiple contracts. The business actively manages contract allocations as a distinct operational entity, tracking allocation percentages, billing methods, cost recovery eligibility, and JOA-specific overhead rates for each JOA-contract pairing to enable accurate joint interest billing and cost sharing among working interest partners.'

Each record links one JOA to one WBS element with attributes that exist only in the context of this cost allocation relationship.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas joint venture operations, a single Joint Operating Agreement commonly governs multiple capital projects across different lifecycle phases (exploration wells, development facilities, production infrastructure), each tracked as separate WBS elements in the project accounting system. Conversely, large multi-venture fields or shared infrastructure projects (e.g., a processing facility serving multiple JOAs) require a single WBS element to track costs that must be allocated across multiple JOAs based on working interest percentages. The business actively manages these allocations to ensure proper AFE-to-WBS mapping, partner cost sharing, and capitalization treatment.'

  joint_venture_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key reference to the specific joint venture or JOA under which this allocation is governed. Provides context for the contractual basis of the allocation arrangement.']
  venture_partner_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key to venture.partner identifying the partner in this allocation relationship']
  afe_number varchar [note: 'The AFE number associated with this allocation, linking the partner-cost center relationship to a specific capital or operating authorization approved by the joint venture partners.']
  allocation_method varchar [note: 'The methodology used to allocate costs from this cost center to this partner. PROPORTIONAL = based on working interest %, FIXED = predetermined amount, STEP_DOWN = hierarchical allocation, ACTIVITY_BASED = driver-based allocation, DIRECT = directly assigned costs.']
  allocation_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of this allocation relationship. ACTIVE = costs are being allocated, SUSPENDED = temporarily paused, PENDING = approved but not yet effective, TERMINATED = allocation has ended.']
  billing_allocation_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether costs allocated through this relationship should be included in joint interest billing (JIB) to the partner. True = costs are billable to partner, False = costs are tracked for reporting but not billed (e.g., operator-absorbed costs).']
  billing_frequency varchar [note: 'The frequency at which costs allocated through this relationship are billed to the partner. Determines the joint interest billing cycle for this partner-cost center combination.']
  created_date timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this allocation record was created in the system.']
  effective_date date [note: 'The date from which this partner-cost center allocation arrangement becomes effective. Supports time-variant allocation relationships as working interests change due to farm-ins, farm-outs, or JOA amendments.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'The date on which this partner-cost center allocation arrangement expires or is superseded by a new arrangement. Null indicates the allocation is currently active with no planned end date.']
  last_modified_by varchar [note: 'User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this allocation record.']
  last_modified_date timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this allocation record.']
  working_interest_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'The percentage of costs from this cost center that are allocated to this partner, based on their working interest in the joint venture. Sum of all partner percentages for a given cost center should equal 100%.']
  created_by varchar [note: 'User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this allocation record.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the cost allocation relationship between joint venture partners and cost centers in joint operating agreements. It captures the working interest percentage, allocation methodology, and billing arrangements that govern how costs accumulated in each cost center are distributed to participating partners. Each record links one partner to one cost center with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific partner-cost center allocation arrangement.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas joint ventures, multiple partners share ownership and costs across multiple cost centers based on their working interest percentages defined in Joint Operating Agreements (JOAs). A partner participates in multiple JOAs, each with numerous cost centers (drilling, production, G&A), and each cost center accumulates costs that must be allocated to multiple partners according to their respective working interests. The business actively manages these allocation relationships, tracking partner-specific percentages, billing methods, effective dates, and AFE authorizations for each partner-cost center combination.'
}

Each record links one partner to one GL account with assignment rules, effective dates, and account usage type that exist only in the context of this relationship. Core to JV accounting automation per COPAS standards.. Existence Justification: In joint venture accounting operations, each partner requires multiple GL account assignments for different transaction types (receivables, payables, revenue share, cost recovery, cash calls), and each GL account serves multiple partners across the venture portfolio. The relationship represents partner-specific account determination rules that drive automated posting in JV accounting systems—a core operational configuration managed by venture accountants and referenced by every JV transaction posting routine.'

  manifest_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the waste manifest. Tracks progression from generation through final disposal confirmation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|in_transit|received|completed|cancelled|rejected — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  manifest_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the manifest based on waste regulatory category. Determines applicable regulatory requirements and handling procedures.']
  norm_activity_level decimal(10,2) [note: 'Measured radioactivity level in picocuries per gram (pCi/g) for NORM-containing waste. Determines classification and disposal pathway.']
  norm_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the waste contains naturally occurring radioactive material. Triggers additional handling, transportation, and disposal requirements specific to NORM waste.']
  rcra_waste_code varchar [note: 'Four-character EPA hazardous waste code(s) identifying the waste characteristics or listing. Multiple codes may be comma-separated. Required for hazardous waste manifests.']
  received_date date [note: 'Date the waste shipment was received at the disposal facility. Completes the manifest tracking cycle and triggers generator notification requirements.']
  rejection_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the waste shipment was rejected by the disposal facility due to non-compliance with waste acceptance criteria or permit conditions.']

  waste_type varchar [note: 'Specific classification of waste material being transported. Examples include drilling mud, produced water, refinery sludge, contaminated soil, NORM scale, spent catalyst, or oily waste.']

Table hse.ldar_inspection {
  ldar_inspection_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for this component inspection record. Primary key.']
  hse_ldar_survey_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the LDAR survey during which this component inspection occurred']
  inspector_employee_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the specific inspector who performed this component inspection, may differ from survey lead inspector']
  ldar_component_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the specific equipment component that was inspected']
  calibration_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent calibration for the monitoring instrument used in this inspection, required for EPA compliance']
  component_condition_observed varchar [note: 'Physical condition of the component observed during inspection: normal, corroded, damaged, loose, missing packing']
  inspection_result varchar [note: 'Outcome classification for this component inspection: no leak detected, leak detected, component inaccessible, component not found, delayed repair approved']
  inspection_sequence_number varchar [note: 'Sequential order in which this component was inspected during the survey, used for audit trail and survey planning']
  inspection_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time when this specific component was inspected during the survey']
  inspector_comments varchar [note: 'Free-text observations and notes recorded by the inspector specific to this component inspection']
  instrument_serial_number varchar [note: 'Serial number of the monitoring instrument used for this component inspection, required for regulatory documentation']
  leak_detected_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a leak exceeding the regulatory threshold was detected at this component during this inspection']
  measured_concentration_ppm decimal(10,2) [note: 'Fugitive emission concentration measured at this component in parts per million during this inspection']
  repair_completion_date date [note: 'Date when the leak repair was completed for this component, if repair was required']
  repair_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether corrective action (leak repair) is required for this component based on this inspection result']
  weather_conditions varchar [note: 'Weather conditions at the time of this specific component inspection, relevant for OGI camera effectiveness']

  Note: 'This association product represents the inspection event between an LDAR survey and an individual equipment component. It captures the specific inspection details for each component examined during a survey, including measurement readings, leak detection results, and inspector observations. Each record links one LDAR survey to one component with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific inspection.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas LDAR operations, each survey inspects multiple components (valves, flanges, connectors, etc.) and each component is inspected across multiple surveys over time to maintain regulatory compliance. The inspection of a specific component during a specific survey is a distinct operational event that HSE coordinators actively manage, with its own measurement data, leak detection results, repair tracking, and regulatory documentation requirements.'
}

  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this incident-substance involvement record was created in the system, typically during incident investigation.']
  environmental_impact_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this specific substance release resulted in environmental impact (soil contamination, water body impact, air quality exceedance). Used for environmental remediation planning and ESG reporting.']
  exposure_duration_minutes varchar [note: 'Duration of personnel exposure to this substance during the incident, measured in minutes. Used with exposure_level_ppm to calculate time-weighted average exposures.']
  exposure_level_ppm decimal(10,2) [note: 'Concentration level of substance exposure measured in parts per million during the incident. Used for H2S exposure incidents and other gas/vapor exposures to assess OSHA PEL exceedances.']
  involvement_type varchar [note: 'Classification of how this substance was involved in the incident. A single incident can involve multiple substances in different ways (e.g., one substance released, another used in response).']
  lopc_quantity decimal(18,3) [note: 'Quantity of material released in loss of primary containment event, measured in barrels for liquids or thousand cubic feet for gases. Used for API RP 754 Tier 1 and Tier 2 classification. [Moved from incident: This attribute currently exists on the incident table but represents the quantity of a SPECIFIC substance released. In incidents involving multiple substances, each substance has its own release quantity. This should be modeled as quantity_released in the association, allowing each incident-substance pair to have its own quantity value.]']
  lopc_unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for the quantity of material released. BBL=Barrels, MCF=Thousand Cubic Feet, LBS=Pounds, KG=Kilograms, GAL=Gallons, L=Liters. [Moved from incident: This attribute is the unit of measure for lopc_quantity and should move with it to the association as release_unit_of_measure. Different substances in the same incident may be measured in different units (e.g., H2S in MCF, crude oil in BBL, produced water in GAL).]']
  personnel_exposed_count varchar [note: 'Number of personnel (employees and contractors) exposed to this specific substance during the incident. Used for industrial hygiene follow-up and medical surveillance.']
  ppe_used varchar [note: 'Personal protective equipment used by responders when handling this specific substance during incident response (e.g., Level A suit, SCBA, chemical-resistant gloves, NORM-rated respirator). Substance-specific because PPE requirements vary by chemical hazard class.']
  quantity_released decimal(18,3) [note: 'Quantity of this specific hazardous substance released in the incident. Critical for CERCLA reportable quantity determination and EPCRA Section 313 release reporting.']
  regulatory_threshold_exceeded_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the quantity released of this specific substance exceeded its CERCLA reportable quantity or other regulatory threshold, triggering mandatory notification to NRC, EPA, or state agencies.']
  release_unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for the quantity released. Must align with regulatory reporting requirements (typically pounds for CERCLA/EPCRA).']

  Note: 'This association product represents the involvement of hazardous substances in HSE incidents. It captures the operational reality that incidents can involve multiple hazardous substances (e.g., a multi-chemical spill, exposure to multiple NORM materials) and that each substance can be involved in multiple incidents over time. Each record links one incident to one hazardous_substance with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific involvement: quantity released, exposure levels, personnel affected, containment methods, and regulatory threshold breach status. This is a first-class operational entity used for EPCRA Section 313 release reporting, RMP accident history documentation, substance-specific risk profiling, and ESG reporting of cumulative releases by chemical.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas HSE operations, incidents routinely involve multiple hazardous substances simultaneously (e.g., a wellhead blowout releasing crude oil, H2S gas, and NORM-contaminated produced water; a tank battery fire involving multiple stored chemicals). Conversely, each hazardous substance is involved in multiple incidents over time, requiring cumulative release tracking for EPCRA Section 313 reporting and substance-specific risk profiling. HSE managers actively manage these incident-substance relationships as operational records during incident investigation, documenting substance-specific release quantities, exposure levels, containment methods, and regulatory threshold breaches.'
}

  max_penalty_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Maximum statutory monetary penalty per violation or per day of non-compliance as defined by the applicable regulation (in USD). Used for risk quantification and CAPEX/OPEX planning for compliance investments.']

  prms_reserves_category varchar [note: 'For SEC reserves disclosure obligations, the Petroleum Resources Management System (PRMS) reserves category to which this obligation applies: 1P (Proved), 2P (Proved plus Probable), 3P (Proved plus Probable plus Possible), PDP (Proved Developed Producing), PUD (Proved Undeveloped), or PDNP (Proved Developed Non-Producing).   regulation_citation varchar [note: 'Specific legal or regulatory citation that creates this obligation (e.g., \'40 CFR Part 98 Subpart W\', \'30 CFR Part 250.1920\', \'49 CFR Part 195.452\', \'SEC Rule 4-10(a)\'). Used for audit trail and legal defensibility.']
  regulatory_body varchar [note: 'Name of the government agency or industry governing body that issued or enforces this obligation (e.g., EPA, BSEE, BOEM, FERC, PHMSA, OSHA, SEC, OPEC, API, SPE, ISO).']
  reporting_form_number varchar [note: 'Official form number or submission template identifier required by the regulatory authority for this obligation (e.g., \'EPA Form 7540-1\', \'BSEE Form MMS-133\', \'SEC Form 10-K\', \'FERC Form 2\'). Supports submission workflow automation.']
  responsible_business_unit varchar [note: 'Name of the internal business unit or division accountable for fulfilling this obligation (e.g., \'Upstream E&P\', \'Refining Operations\', \'HSE Compliance\', \'Finance and Reporting\', \'Supply Chain\').   responsible_department varchar [note: 'Specific department within the responsible business unit that owns day-to-day compliance actions for this obligation (e.g., \'Environmental Affairs\', \'Drilling Engineering\', \'Regulatory Affairs\', \'Legal\').']
  source_instrument_number varchar [note: 'Official number or identifier of the permit, license, consent order, or regulation that is the source of this obligation (e.g., permit number, docket number, consent decree case number). Links to the permit register.']
  source_instrument_type varchar [note: 'Type of legal instrument from which this obligation is derived: federal_regulation, state_regulation, permit, license, consent_order, settlement_agreement, executive_order, or tariff. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: federal_regulation|state_regulation|permit|license|consent_order|settlement_agreement|executive_order|tariff — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  sox_control_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this obligation is linked to a Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) internal control (True) and must be included in the annual SOX 302/404 certification process.']
  submission_deadline_days varchar [note: 'Number of calendar days after the trigger event or period end by which the compliance submission must be filed with the regulatory authority (e.g., 30 days after fiscal year end for SEC annual reserves disclosure).']

  Note: 'Master catalog of all regulatory compliance obligations applicable to the company derived from federal and state regulations, permits, licenses, consent orders, and settlement agreements. Each obligation defines the regulatory requirement, applicable regulation citation, responsible business unit, frequency of compliance action, due date logic, consequence of non-compliance, and current compliance status. Serves as the authoritative register of what the company must do to remain compliant and the central hub linking permits, filings, violations, and calendar events.'
}

  source_system varchar [note: 'Name of the operational system of record from which this compliance calendar event was originated or ingested (e.g., Enablon HSE Management for HSE compliance events, SAP S/4HANA for financial regulatory filings, Quorum for land and lease permit renewals).']

  vendor_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Corrective actions often require vendor services (remediation contractors, equipment suppliers, consulting engineers). Real business process: corrective action execution via procurement. Links CAPA to']
  work_order_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the Maximo Asset Management work order created to execute the physical or maintenance activities required by this corrective action (e.g., equipment repair, LDAR survey, BOP inspection). Links compliance management to asset maintenance execution.']
  action_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative describing the specific corrective or preventive action to be taken, including the scope of work, methodology, and expected outcome. Supports regulatory closure documentation and audit evidence packages.']
  action_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the corrective action record. Drives compliance calendar tracking and regulatory closure documentation. Transitions: open → in_progress → pending_verification → closed. Overdue is a system-flagged state when target completion date is exceeded.']
  action_title varchar [note: 'Short, descriptive title summarizing the corrective action. Used as the primary display label in compliance dashboards, regulatory submissions, and management reports.']
  action_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the action as corrective (addressing a known violation or nonconformance), preventive (proactively eliminating potential causes), immediate (emergency interim measure), systemic (root-cause-driven process change), or regulatory_directed (mandated by a regulatory authority such as BSEE, EPA, or PHMSA).']
  actual_completion_date date [note: 'Date on which the corrective action was fully implemented and all required activities were completed. Compared against target_completion_date to assess timeliness and regulatory compliance. Null until the action is completed.']
  actual_cost_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'Actual total cost in US dollars incurred to implement the corrective action upon completion. Compared against estimated_cost_usd for budget variance analysis and financial reporting. Null until the action is completed and costs are finalized.']
  capa_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known, human-readable reference number assigned to the corrective and preventive action record. Used in regulatory submissions, audit correspondence, and government reporting. Format: CAPA-YYYY-NNNNNN.']
  comments varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional notes, management commentary, or contextual information related to the corrective action that does not fit into structured fields. Supports audit trail documentation and regulatory correspondence.']
  compliance_domain varchar [note: 'Business compliance domain to which this corrective action belongs, enabling cross-domain analytics and portfolio management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hse|environmental|financial|operational|safety|pipeline|offshore|reserves|process_safety|esg — promote to reference product]']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Audit timestamp recording when this corrective action record was first created in the data system. Distinct from initiated_timestamp which reflects the business event time. Supports SOX audit trail requirements.']
  effectiveness_review_date date [note: 'Date on which the effectiveness review was conducted to assess whether the corrective action successfully prevented recurrence of the violation or compliance gap. Typically performed 30-90 days after action closure.']
  effectiveness_review_notes varchar [note: 'Narrative documentation of the effectiveness review findings, including evidence of recurrence prevention, residual risks identified, and any follow-up actions recommended. Supports regulatory audit evidence packages.']
  effectiveness_review_status varchar [note: 'Outcome of the post-implementation effectiveness review assessing whether the corrective action successfully eliminated the root cause and prevented recurrence. Supports continuous improvement tracking and regulatory audit readiness.']
  esg_category varchar [note: 'ESG reporting category to which this corrective action contributes, enabling aggregation for ESG disclosures, sustainability reports, and investor reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: environmental|social|governance|safety|ghg_emissions|spill|waste|biodiversity|human_rights — promote to reference product]']
  estimated_cost_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'Estimated total cost in US dollars to implement the corrective action, including labor, materials, contractor services, and equipment. Used for CAPEX/OPEX budgeting, AFE preparation, and financial reporting under SOX and IFRS/GAAP.']
  facility_name varchar [note: 'Name of the facility or installation where the corrective action is being implemented. Retained directly on the record for regulatory reporting and correspondence where the facility master may not be accessible.']
  initiated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the corrective action was formally initiated and entered into the compliance management system. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this transaction. Used to calculate response time against regulatory deadlines.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Audit timestamp recording the most recent modification to this corrective action record. Supports change tracking, SOX internal controls, and regulatory audit trail documentation.']
  priority_level varchar [note: 'Business priority assigned to the corrective action based on regulatory risk, safety impact, and potential penalty exposure. Critical actions typically involve imminent regulatory deadlines or safety-critical systems (e.g., BOP integrity, H2S exposure controls).']
  recurrence_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this corrective action addresses a recurring violation or compliance gap that has previously been subject to a corrective action. Recurrence triggers escalated regulatory scrutiny and may indicate systemic management system failure under BSEE SEMS II.']
  regulatory_authority varchar [note: 'The regulatory body or governing authority whose requirement, inspection finding, or directive triggered or is associated with this corrective action (e.g., BSEE for offshore safety, EPA for environmental violations, PHMSA for pipeline safety, OSHA for workplace safety). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BSEE|EPA|PHMSA|OSHA|FERC|BOEM|SEC|OPEC|API|STATE|OTHER — promote to reference product]']
  regulatory_citation varchar [note: 'Specific regulatory code, rule, or standard citation that was violated or is being addressed by this corrective action (e.g., \'30 CFR 250.1920\', \'40 CFR 60.18\', \'49 CFR 195.452\'). Used in regulatory correspondence and closure documentation.']
  regulatory_closure_date date [note: 'Date on which the regulatory authority formally acknowledged and accepted the closure of the corrective action, confirming that all regulatory requirements have been satisfied. Null until regulatory closure is confirmed.']
  regulatory_closure_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether formal regulatory closure documentation must be submitted to a regulatory authority (e.g., BSEE, EPA, PHMSA) upon completion of this corrective action. Drives the compliance calendar and submission workflow.']
  regulatory_deadline_date date [note: 'Externally mandated deadline imposed by a regulatory authority (e.g., BSEE, EPA, PHMSA) for completion of the corrective action. Distinct from the internal target_completion_date. Breach of this date may result in penalties, fines, or escalated enforcement action.']
  regulatory_submission_ref varchar [note: 'Reference number or tracking identifier assigned by the regulatory authority upon submission of the corrective action plan or closure documentation (e.g., BSEE incident number, EPA enforcement case number, PHMSA corrective action order number).']
  responsible_department varchar [note: 'Organizational department or business unit accountable for executing the corrective action (e.g., HSE, Drilling, Production, Refining, Regulatory Affairs). Used for workload distribution reporting and compliance performance analytics.']
  responsible_party_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the individual assigned as the primary owner accountable for executing and completing the corrective action. Retained directly on the record for regulatory reporting and audit documentation where the workforce system may not be accessible.']
  root_cause_category varchar [note: 'Standardized classification of the root cause type to enable trend analysis and systemic improvement tracking across the compliance portfolio. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: human_factor|process_failure|equipment_failure|management_system|regulatory_gap|environmental|design_deficiency|contractor_performance — promote to reference product if additional categories are needed]']
  root_cause_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the identified root cause(s) of the violation, nonconformance, or compliance gap that necessitated this corrective action. Derived from root cause analysis (RCA) methodologies such as 5-Why or fishbone analysis.']
  target_completion_date date [note: 'Planned date by which the corrective action must be fully implemented and verified. May be set by internal management or mandated by a regulatory authority as part of a Notice of Violation (NOV) or Consent Order response deadline.']
  verification_date date [note: 'Date on which the verification activity was performed to confirm effective implementation of the corrective action. Required for regulatory closure packages submitted to BSEE, EPA, PHMSA, or other authorities.']
  verification_method varchar [note: 'Method used to verify that the corrective action has been effectively implemented. Options include physical inspection, internal audit, functional test, document review, field observation, or independent third-party audit as required by regulatory authorities.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) initiated in response to regulatory violations, audit findings, or compliance gaps. Tracks action description, responsible party, target completion date, actual completion date, verification method, effectiveness review, and linkage to the originating violation or audit finding. Supports regulatory closure documentation.'
}

  crude_grade_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to product.crude_grade.   pud_years_booked varchar [note: 'Number of consecutive years this PUD location has been carried in the proved undeveloped reserves category. SEC guidance limits PUD bookings to five years unless specific circumstances justify longer periods; this field supports compliance monitoring.']
  quantity_unit varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for the proved reserves quantity: MBBLS = Thousand Barrels (oil/NGL/condensate); MMBBLS = Million Barrels; BCFE = Billion Cubic Feet Equivalent (gas); MMCFE = Million Cubic Feet Equivalent; MBOE = Thousand Barrels of Oil Equivalent; MMBOE = Million Barrels of Oil Equivalent.']
  reporting_period_year varchar [note: 'The fiscal year (four-digit integer, e.g., 2024) for which proved reserves are being disclosed. SEC Rule 4-10 mandates annual reserves disclosure as of December 31 of the reporting year.']
  reserve_category varchar [note: 'SPE-PRMS reserves classification tier: 1P = Proved reserves (SEC-mandated minimum disclosure); 2P = Proved plus Probable; 3P = Proved plus Probable plus Possible. SEC Rule 4-10 requires 1P disclosure; 2P and 3P are supplemental.']
  reserve_subcategory varchar [note: 'Proved reserves development status subcategory: PDP = Proved Developed Producing (currently producing wells); PDNP = Proved Developed Non-Producing (completed but not producing); PUD = Proved Undeveloped (requires future capital investment). Required for SEC 10-K disclosure.']
  reservoir_name varchar [note: 'The specific reservoir or formation name within the field to which these reserves are attributed (e.g., Permian Wolfcamp, Eagle Ford Shale). Supports sub-field granularity for reservoir management and SEC supplemental disclosures.']
  revision_quantity decimal(18,4) [note: 'Net upward or downward revision to proved reserves quantities from the prior year\'s disclosure, expressed in the same unit as proved_reserves_quantity. Positive values indicate upward revisions; negative values indicate downward revisions. Required for SEC rollforward reconciliation.']
  revision_reason varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the primary reason for reserves revisions during the reporting period (e.g., price revisions, performance revisions, technical reinterpretation, infill drilling results). Required for SEC Regulation S-K Item 1203 qualitative disclosure of material changes.']
  standardized_measure_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'The SEC-mandated standardized measure of discounted future net cash flows from proved reserves, expressed in USD. Calculated using 12-month average first-day-of-month prices and a 10% annual discount rate per SFAS 69 / ASC 932. Required supplemental oil and gas disclosure.']
  twelve_month_avg_price decimal(12,4) [note: 'The unweighted arithmetic average of the first-day-of-month commodity price for the 12 months of the reporting year, used as the SEC-mandated pricing basis for proved reserves estimation and standardized measure calculation. Expressed in USD per barrel (oil/NGL) or USD per Mcf (gas).']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this reserves disclosure record. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED field for audit trail and change tracking purposes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  working_interest decimal(10,6) [note: 'The company\'s working interest percentage (decimal fraction, e.g., 0.500000 = 50%) in the property or lease associated with these reserves. WI represents the obligation to bear costs of exploration, development, and production.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of SEC-mandated proved reserves disclosures filed annually under SEC Rule 4-10. Captures 1P (proved), 2P, and 3P reserve quantities by category (PDP, PUD, PDNP), commodity type (oil, gas, NGL), geographic region, and reporting period. Tracks SEC filing reference, independent engineer certification, revision history, and PRMS classification alignment. Supports annual 10-K and 20-F filings.'

Table compliance.opec_quota_position {
  opec_quota_position_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each OPEC quota position record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this transactional entity.']
  compliance_regulatory_filing_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: OPEC quota positions require production reports to be filed with the OPEC secretariat. The table has production_report_submission_date and production_report_ref. Adding regulatory_filing_id FK links t']
  actual_production_bopd decimal(12,2) [note: 'The actual average daily crude oil production volume reported for the quota period, expressed in BOPD. Sourced from OSIsoft PI System production historian and Avocet Production Operations daily allocation data. This is the figure submitted to the OPEC Secretariat.']
  allocated_quota_bopd decimal(12,2) [note: 'The official OPEC-assigned production quota for the member country or company for the quota period, expressed in Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD). This is the baseline entitlement as communicated by the OPEC Secretariat and forms the compliance benchmark.']
  approval_date date [note: 'The date on which the quota position record was formally approved by the designated approver for submission to the OPEC Secretariat. Part of the SOX-compliant internal control audit trail.']
  approved_by varchar [note: 'Name or employee identifier of the senior manager or executive who approved the production report and quota compliance position for submission to the OPEC Secretariat. Supports SOX internal control documentation.']
  baseline_reference_bopd decimal(12,2) [note: 'The reference production level (in BOPD) used by OPEC as the baseline from which quota cuts or increases are calculated. Typically corresponds to a specific historical production month agreed upon in the ministerial conference decision.']
  compensation_plan_bopd decimal(12,2) [note: 'The agreed additional production curtailment (in BOPD below quota) committed by the member for the current period as part of a formal compensation plan to offset prior overproduction. Null if no compensation plan is active.']
  compliance_officer_name varchar [note: 'Name of the designated compliance officer or regulatory affairs manager responsible for overseeing OPEC quota compliance for this period. Used for accountability tracking and regulatory correspondence.']
  compliance_status varchar [note: 'Current compliance status of the quota position for the period. \'compliant\' = production within quota; \'overproduced\' = production exceeds quota; \'underproduced\' = production below quota; \'pending_verification\' = awaiting final production data; \'disputed\' = member disputes OPEC assessment; \'compensating\' = member is executing a compensation plan for prior overproduction.']
  condensate_excluded_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether natural gas condensate volumes have been excluded from the reported production figure in accordance with OPEC quota measurement conventions. True = condensate excluded; False = condensate included. OPEC quotas historically apply to crude oil only, excluding condensate.']
  conference_decision_reference varchar [note: 'Official reference number or identifier of the OPEC Ministerial Conference decision that established or last amended the quota allocation for this period (e.g., Decision 178 of the 186th Extraordinary Meeting). Provides traceability to the governing OPEC resolution.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this OPEC quota position record was first created in the Silver Layer data product, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit creation trail required for SOX compliance and data lineage.']
  crude_type_code varchar [note: 'API or industry-standard code identifying the crude oil grade or stream included in the production volume (e.g., Arab Light, Basrah Heavy, Bonny Light). Relevant where OPEC quota applies to specific crude streams or where condensate exclusions apply.']
  cumulative_overproduction_bopd decimal(12,2) [note: 'The running cumulative overproduction volume (in BOPD) carried forward from prior periods that has not yet been compensated through production curtailment. A non-zero value triggers a compensation obligation under OPEC ministerial decisions.']
  curtailment_plan_status varchar [note: 'Status of the internal production curtailment plan developed to ensure compliance with the OPEC quota for this period. \'not_required\' = production within quota; \'planned\' = curtailment plan drafted; \'active\' = curtailment being executed; \'completed\' = curtailment achieved; \'deferred\' = curtailment postponed.']
  curtailment_target_bopd decimal(12,2) [note: 'The planned production reduction (in BOPD) required to bring actual production into compliance with the effective quota. Derived from the curtailment plan and used to guide field-level production scheduling decisions.']
  data_source_system varchar [note: 'Identifies the operational system of record from which the actual_production_bopd figure was sourced for this quota period. Supports data lineage, audit, and reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OSIsoft_PI|Avocet|SAP_S4HANA|Manual_Entry|SCADA|Other — promote to reference product]']
  dispute_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the basis for the dispute raised against the OPEC Secretariat\'s compliance assessment, including the nature of the disagreement, supporting data references, and the resolution sought. Populated only when dispute_flag is True.']
  dispute_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the member country or company has formally disputed the OPEC Secretariat\'s assessment of production volumes or compliance status for this quota period. True = dispute raised; False = no dispute. Triggers escalation workflow.']
  effective_quota_bopd decimal(12,2) [note: 'The net effective production ceiling for the period in BOPD, calculated as allocated_quota_bopd minus voluntary_cut_bopd minus compensation_plan_bopd. Represents the actual production target the member must not exceed to remain fully compliant.']
  esg_ghg_reporting_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the production volumes in this quota position are included in the company\'s ESG/GHG emissions reporting scope. True = included in GHG inventory; False = excluded. Supports alignment between OPEC production compliance and EPA/ESG emissions disclosure obligations.']
  internal_review_status varchar [note: 'Workflow status of the internal review and approval process for this quota position record before submission to the OPEC Secretariat. \'draft\' = initial entry; \'under_review\' = compliance team reviewing; \'approved\' = management approved; \'submitted\' = filed with OPEC; \'closed\' = period finalized.']
  member_country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the OPEC member state to which this quota position applies (e.g., SAU, IRQ, ARE, IRN, KWT, VEN, NGA, LBY, GAB, COG, GNQ, AGO). Used to align production data with OPEC secretariat country-level reporting.']
  member_country_name varchar [note: 'Full official name of the OPEC member country corresponding to the member_country_code. Provides human-readable identification for reporting and correspondence with the OPEC Secretariat.']
  next_review_date date [note: 'The scheduled date of the next OPEC Ministerial Conference or Joint Ministerial Monitoring Committee (JMMC) meeting at which this quota may be reviewed or adjusted. Used for compliance calendar planning and curtailment strategy.']
  ngl_excluded_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) volumes have been excluded from the reported production figure per OPEC quota measurement conventions. True = NGL excluded; False = NGL included. Ensures consistency with OPEC crude-only quota scope.']
  opec_plus_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this quota position is governed under the broader OPEC+ (Declaration of Cooperation) framework, which includes non-OPEC allied producers such as Russia, Kazakhstan, and Mexico, in addition to core OPEC members. True = OPEC+ agreement applies; False = core OPEC quota only.']
  production_measurement_basis varchar [note: 'Defines the accounting basis on which the actual production volume is reported: \'gross\' = total field production before deductions; \'net\' = production net of royalties and government take; \'equity\' = company equity share; \'working_interest\' = Working Interest (WI) share of production.']
  production_report_ref varchar [note: 'Official reference or submission number assigned to the production report filed with the OPEC Secretariat for this quota period. Enables cross-referencing with secretariat records and internal compliance audit trails.']
  production_report_submission_date date [note: 'The date on which the company or member state submitted its official production report for the quota period to the OPEC Secretariat. Used to verify timely compliance with OPEC reporting obligations.']
  quota_adjustment_bopd decimal(12,2) [note: 'The incremental adjustment (positive for increase, negative for cut) applied to the baseline reference to arrive at the allocated quota for this period, expressed in BOPD. Captures voluntary cut commitments, compensation adjustments, and OPEC+ agreement modifications.']
  quota_period_end_date date [note: 'The last calendar date of the OPEC production quota period to which this position record applies. Together with quota_period_start_date, defines the compliance measurement window.']
  quota_period_label varchar [note: 'Human-readable label for the quota period, formatted as YYYY-MM for monthly periods (e.g., 2024-03) or YYYY-Q# for quarterly periods (e.g., 2024-Q1). Used in regulatory submissions and management reporting.']
  quota_period_start_date date [note: 'The first calendar date of the OPEC production quota period to which this position record applies. OPEC quota periods are typically monthly or quarterly as determined by ministerial conference decisions.']
  quota_review_cycle varchar [note: 'The frequency at which the OPEC quota for this period is subject to ministerial review and potential adjustment. Reflects the cadence established in the relevant ministerial conference decision.']
  quota_utilization_pct decimal(7,4) [note: 'The ratio of actual_production_bopd to allocated_quota_bopd expressed as a percentage (actual / quota × 100). Values above 100 indicate overproduction; values below 100 indicate underproduction. Used in executive dashboards and OPEC compliance reporting.']
  record_version varchar [note: 'Monotonically incrementing version number for this quota position record, incremented each time the record is updated. Supports optimistic concurrency control and audit trail reconstruction in the Silver Layer lakehouse.']
  responsible_entity_name varchar [note: 'Name of the internal business unit, subsidiary, or operating company responsible for managing and reporting the production volumes covered by this quota position. Supports accountability assignment in multi-entity corporate structures.']
  secretariat_correspondence_ref varchar [note: 'Official document reference number of the OPEC Secretariat letter or communication notifying the member of the quota allocation or adjustment. Supports audit trail and regulatory correspondence management.']
  secretariat_notification_date date [note: 'The date on which the OPEC Secretariat formally communicated the quota allocation for this period to the member country. Used to establish the official notification timeline for compliance and audit purposes.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp of the most recent update to this OPEC quota position record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Updated on every modification to support change tracking, audit trails, and SOX internal control documentation.']
  variance_bopd decimal(12,2) [note: 'The arithmetic difference between actual_production_bopd and allocated_quota_bopd (actual minus quota), expressed in BOPD. A positive value indicates overproduction (non-compliance); a negative value indicates underproduction relative to quota. Used for curtailment planning and compliance assessment.']
  voluntary_cut_bopd decimal(12,2) [note: 'Additional voluntary production cut (in BOPD) committed by the member above and beyond the mandatory OPEC quota reduction, as announced unilaterally or through side agreements. Null if no voluntary cut is in effect for this period.']

  Note: 'Transactional record tracking the company\'s or member state\'s OPEC production quota allocation, actual production volumes, and compliance position for each quota period. Captures allocated quota in BOPD, actual production reported, variance from quota, quota adjustment notifications, and OPEC secretariat correspondence. Supports OPEC compliance reporting and production curtailment planning.'
}

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Existence|Completeness|Accuracy|Valuation|Rights and Obligations|Cutoff|Presentation and Disclosure — promote to reference product]']

  test_reference_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for this control test, used in audit workpapers, management assessment documentation, and external auditor reliance packages. Format: SOX-TST-YYYY-NNNNNN.']
  test_status varchar [note: 'Current workflow state of the control test record. Tracks progression from planning through execution to completion or cancellation. Supports SOX 404 management assessment completeness monitoring.']

  testing_methodology varchar [note: 'The audit testing approach applied to evaluate the control. Aligned with PCAOB AS 2201 testing procedures. Determines the nature and sufficiency of evidence gathered for external auditor reliance.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this SOX control test record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail integrity, and SOX 404 documentation version control.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of SOX internal control testing activities performed during each assessment period. Supports external auditor reliance and SOX 404 management assessment documentation.'

  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this consent order record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this consent order record (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multinational financial reporting under IFRS/GAAP.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date on which the consent order becomes legally binding and enforceable, as stipulated in the instrument. Marks the start of the compliance obligation period and triggers milestone scheduling.']
  enablon_case_ref varchar [note: 'Reference identifier for the corresponding enforcement case or compliance obligation record in the Enablon HSE Management system. Enables traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational system of record.']
  execution_date date [note: 'Date on which the consent order was formally signed or entered by all parties (company and regulatory agency), which may differ from the effective date. Represents the principal real-world business event timestamp for this agreement.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'Date on which the consent order expires or all obligations are scheduled to be fully discharged, as specified in the instrument. Null for open-ended orders with no fixed termination. Used for compliance calendar management.']
  fulfillment_status varchar [note: 'Current operational fulfillment status of the consent order\'s compliance obligations: on_track (milestones being met), at_risk (potential delay identified), overdue (missed milestone or report), fulfilled (all obligations satisfied), or partially_fulfilled (some milestones complete). Distinct from order_status which reflects the legal lifecycle.']
  ghg_related boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the consent order relates to greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions violations, including methane, CO2, or other regulated GHG emissions under EPA Clean Air Act or state equivalents. Supports GHG compliance and ESG reporting.']
  hse_classification varchar [note: 'HSE domain classification of the consent order: environmental (spills, emissions, waste disposal), safety (worker safety, OSHA), health (occupational health), process_safety (PSM, BSEE), or combined (multiple HSE domains). Aligns with Enablon HSE Management categorization.']
  is_esg_reportable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this consent order must be disclosed in the company\'s ESG or sustainability report. True for orders involving GHG emissions, environmental spills, HSE violations, or other ESG-material events.']
  is_sec_reportable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this consent order meets the materiality threshold requiring disclosure in SEC filings under Regulation S-K Item 103 (Legal Proceedings). True if the penalty exceeds $300,000 or is otherwise material to investors.']
  issuing_agency varchar [note: 'Name of the federal, state, or international regulatory agency that issued or is party to the consent order (e.g., U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement, Occupational Safety and Health Administration, state environmental agency). Determines applicable regulatory framework.']
  jurisdiction_level varchar [note: 'Level of governmental jurisdiction under which the consent order was issued: federal (EPA, BSEE, OSHA, PHMSA, FERC, BOEM), state (state environmental or safety agency), local (county or municipal authority), or international (foreign regulatory body). Determines reporting chain and legal venue.']
  jurisdiction_state_code varchar [note: 'Two-letter U.S. state code (FIPS/USPS standard) for the state in which the consent order has legal effect, or the state agency that issued it. Null for purely federal or international orders.']
  last_report_submitted_date date [note: 'Date on which the most recent mandatory compliance progress report was submitted to the issuing regulatory agency. Used to verify reporting cadence adherence and identify overdue submissions.']
  legal_counsel_name varchar [note: 'Name of the internal or external legal counsel representing the company in negotiations and ongoing compliance management for this consent order. Supports attorney-client privilege tracking and legal matter management.']
  milestone_count varchar [note: 'Total number of distinct compliance milestones or deliverables stipulated in the consent order (e.g., equipment installation deadlines, audit submissions, monitoring report due dates). Used for progress tracking and compliance calendar population.']
  milestones_completed_count varchar [note: 'Number of compliance milestones that have been fulfilled and accepted by the regulatory agency to date. Compared against milestone_count to assess overall fulfillment progress.']
  next_milestone_due_date date [note: 'Date by which the next outstanding compliance milestone or deliverable must be completed and submitted to the regulatory agency. Drives compliance calendar alerts and escalation workflows in Enablon HSE Management.']
  next_report_due_date date [note: 'Date by which the next mandatory progress or compliance status report must be submitted to the issuing regulatory agency under the consent order\'s reporting obligations.']
  order_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known docket or case number assigned by the issuing regulatory agency to uniquely identify this consent order, consent decree, or settlement agreement (e.g., EPA Docket No. CAA-06-2023-0042). Used for all regulatory correspondence and submissions.']
  order_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the consent order: active (in force and obligations ongoing), fulfilled (all milestones and penalties satisfied), terminated (voided or withdrawn), superseded (replaced by a subsequent order), or under_negotiation (draft stage prior to execution). Drives compliance calendar and SOX disclosure.']
  order_title varchar [note: 'Official short title or caption of the consent order as designated by the issuing agency, used for identification in regulatory filings, internal compliance registers, and SEC disclosure documents.']
  order_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the regulatory instrument: consent_order (administrative), consent_decree (judicial/court-entered), settlement_agreement (negotiated resolution), administrative_order (unilateral agency directive), or compliance_order (corrective mandate). Determines legal enforceability and reporting treatment.']
  regulation_citation varchar [note: 'Specific statutory or regulatory citation(s) that form the legal basis for the consent order (e.g., Clean Air Act § 113(d), 40 CFR Part 60, 30 CFR § 250.401). Supports regulatory compliance mapping and legal review.']
  reporting_frequency varchar [note: 'Frequency at which progress reports must be submitted to the issuing regulatory agency under the terms of the consent order: monthly, quarterly, semi_annual, annual, one_time, or as_required. Populates the compliance obligation calendar.']
  responsible_business_unit varchar [note: 'Name of the internal business unit, division, or operating company accountable for managing compliance with this consent order (e.g., Upstream E&P, Refining and Marketing, Midstream Pipeline Operations). Aligns with SAP CO cost center hierarchy.']
  sap_legal_case_number varchar [note: 'Reference number for the corresponding legal case or provision record in SAP S/4HANA (FI/Legal module) used for financial provisioning, penalty accruals, and CAPEX/OPEX cost tracking associated with this consent order.']
  sep_credit_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Dollar value of penalty mitigation credit granted for Supplemental Environmental Projects (SEPs) agreed to as part of the consent order settlement. SEPs are environmentally beneficial projects that reduce the net cash penalty obligation. Specific to EPA enforcement settlements.']
  stipulated_penalty_per_day decimal(18,2) [note: 'Daily stipulated penalty amount (in the designated currency) that accrues for each day of non-compliance with a milestone or reporting obligation under the consent order. Critical for financial risk quantification and CAPEX/OPEX planning.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this consent order record was most recently modified in the lakehouse silver layer, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking, audit trail, and SOX internal controls.']

  Note: 'Master record of consent orders, consent decrees, and settlement agreements entered into with regulatory agencies including EPA, BSEE, OSHA, and state regulators. Tracks issuing agency, violation basis, agreed remediation actions, penalty amounts, compliance milestones, reporting obligations imposed by the order, and current fulfillment status.'
}

  paid_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Actual monetary amount paid to the regulatory authority to date. May be less than settled_amount if payment is in installments or partially paid. Supports cash flow reporting and accounts payable reconciliation.']

  payment_due_date date [note: 'Date by which the penalty payment must be remitted to the regulatory authority to avoid additional interest, late fees, or escalated enforcement. Drives accounts payable scheduling.']
  payment_status varchar [note: 'Current payment status of the penalty amount. Drives accounts payable follow-up, interest accrual, and regulatory relationship management.']
  penalty_number varchar [note: 'Externally assigned penalty or civil penalty case number issued by the regulatory authority (e.g., EPA enforcement case number, BSEE incident of non-compliance number, PHMSA penalty order number). Used for correspondence and regulatory tracking.']
  penalty_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the regulatory penalty. Drives financial accrual decisions and regulatory liability disclosure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: assessed|contested|settled|paid|waived|appealed|closed — promote to reference product]']
  penalty_title varchar [note: 'Short descriptive title of the penalty or enforcement action as designated by the assessing regulatory authority (e.g., \'Notice of Violation - Flaring Exceedance\', \'Civil Penalty Order - Pipeline Integrity\').']
  regulation_citation varchar [note: 'Specific regulatory citation, statute, or code section under which the penalty was assessed (e.g., \'Clean Air Act Section 113(b)\', \'30 CFR Part 250\', \'49 CFR Part 195\'). Supports legal defense and compliance gap analysis.']
  regulation_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the regulation, rule, or statute under which the penalty was assessed (e.g., \'Clean Air Act\', \'Clean Water Act\', \'Pipeline Safety Improvement Act\', \'Outer Continental Shelf Lands Act\').']
  repeat_violation boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this penalty arises from a repeat violation of the same regulation or permit condition within a defined lookback period. Repeat violations typically attract higher penalty multipliers and heightened regulatory scrutiny.']
  responsible_business_unit varchar [note: 'Name of the business unit or division within Oil Gas that is accountable for the violation and responsible for penalty payment and corrective action (e.g., Upstream E&P, Refining, Midstream, Petrochemicals).']
  sap_document_number varchar [note: 'SAP S/4HANA FI module document number for the financial posting (accrual or payment) associated with this penalty. Enables reconciliation between the compliance register and the general ledger.']
  settled_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Final negotiated or adjudicated penalty amount agreed upon after appeal, mitigation, or settlement proceedings. May differ from assessed_amount due to reductions granted by the authority. Used for final financial accrual and SEC disclosure.']
  state_code varchar [note: 'Two-letter US state code for the jurisdiction where the violation occurred and penalty was assessed. Applicable for state-level enforcement actions.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this regulatory penalty record was last modified in the compliance management system. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and SOX internal controls.']
  well_api_number varchar [note: 'American Petroleum Institute (API) well number for the specific well associated with the violation, applicable for drilling, production, or well integrity violations assessed by BSEE or state regulators.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of monetary penalties, fines, and civil penalties assessed by regulatory authorities for compliance violations. Tracks penalty amount, assessing authority, violation basis, assessment date, payment due date, payment status, appeal status, and final settled amount. Supports financial accrual reporting and regulatory liability disclosure.'
